title: Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM) Lead  - Huntsville, Alabama
description:
Davidson is distinguished in the aerospace and missile defense industry, in part, because of its excellence in hiring exceptional experts, engineers and software developers dedicated to delivering advanced, intelligent technology solutions in defense of our nation.

Position Summary

Davidsons Warfighter Integration (WFI) team is looking for a cyber security professional that moves at the speed of the mission-not just operating as an afterthought or administrative checkpoint. We are seeking an experienced Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM) Lead in Huntsville, Alabama to establish, lead, and oversee cybersecurity activities across a diverse portfolio of advanced defense programs and technologies.


This role will serve as the senior cybersecurity authority within WFI, leading the cyber team, shaping security processes, and ensuring systems achieve and maintain the authorizations required to operate in demanding Department of War environments. The ISSM Lead will oversee the development of Authority to Operate (ATO) and Authority to Connect (ATC) packages, manage cybersecurity risk throughout the system lifecycle, and serve as the primary interface with customers, Authorizing Officials, security stakeholders, and program leadership.

This is not a position focused solely on compliance documentation. The ISSM Lead will work directly with systems, software, network, DevSecOps, and integration teams to build cybersecurity into solutions from the beginning. WFI supports a fast-paced and evolving technology portfolio, giving this individual broad exposure to Command and Control, tactical networks, data fusion, cloud and edge computing, embedded systems, sensors, and other emerging warfighter technologies. The ideal candidate combines strong RMF expertise with the leadership, judgment, and communication skills required to turn cybersecurity requirements into executable engineering actions.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead and oversee cybersecurity personnel, priorities, and activities across the WFI organization.
  • Serve as the primary cybersecurity interface with customers, Authorizing Officials, assessors, program leadership, and external security stakeholders.
  • Lead the development, submission, and maintenance of ATO and ATC packages.
  • Establish and mature WFI cybersecurity processes, governance, and authorization strategies.
  • Ensure systems comply with RMF, NIST, DISA, and customer-specific cybersecurity requirements.
  • Coordinate security control implementation, evidence development, assessment activities, vulnerability management, and remediation.
  • Integrate cybersecurity requirements into system architectures, software development, DevSecOps, testing, and deployment activities.
  • Manage cybersecurity risks, POA&Ms, authorization status, and continuous monitoring across the WFI portfolio.
  • Provide clear cybersecurity status, risks, recommendations, and decisions to program and executive leadership.
  • Mentor and develop cybersecurity personnel while building a responsive, execution-focused cyber team.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Eight or more years of cybersecurity or information assurance experience supporting DoD systems.
  • Demonstrated experience serving as an ISSM, cybersecurity lead, or equivalent technical leadership role.
  • Experience leading cybersecurity teams and coordinating activities across multiple programs or systems.
  • Hands-on experience developing and managing RMF authorization packages through ATO and ATC approval.
  • Strong knowledge of NIST RMF, NIST SP 800-53, DISA STIGs, vulnerability management, and continuous monitoring.
  • Experience coordinating with Authorizing Officials, Security Control Assessors, customer cyber personnel, and engineering teams.
  • Ability to translate cybersecurity requirements and risks into clear technical and programmatic actions.
  • Strong communication, organization, leadership, and customer-interface skills.
  • Active Secret clearance

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience establishing or leading cybersecurity organizations, teams, or governance frameworks.
  • Experience supporting RMF authorization for DoD software-intensive systems.
  • Experience with Command and Control (C2), sensor integration, data fusion, tactical communications, or weapon systems.
  • Experience with cloud, embedded, tactical edge, or classified computing environments.
  • Familiarity with DevSecOps, CI/CD pipelines, containerized applications, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Experience with eMASS, Platform IT (PIT), or equivalent DoD authorization processes.
  • Experience with cross-domain solutions, multi-level security (MLS), and tactical networks.
  • Experience implementing DISA STIGs, SCAP, and cybersecurity compliance tools.
  • Experience with ACAS, Nessus, Tenable, or similar vulnerability management platforms.
  • Knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA), Identity and Access Management (IAM), PKI, and encryption technologies.
  • Experience supporting open architectures, MOSA, and systems-of-systems integration.
  • Experience developing cybersecurity requirements, security architectures, and verification strategies.
  • Professional cybersecurity certifications (CISSP, CISM, CGRC/CAP, Security+, or equivalent DoD 8140 certification).DoD 8140 certification).
  • Active Top Secret clearance with SCI

Preferred Certifications

  • DoW 8140-compliant certification appropriate for the assigned cybersecurity workforce role.
  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP).
  • Certified Information Security Manager (CISM).
  • Certified Authorization Professional or Certified in Governance, Risk and Compliance.
  • CompTIA Security+.
  • CompTIA Cybersecurity Analyst.

Security Clearance

  • Active Secret security clearance required.
  • Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility preferred.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain additional program-specific accesses as required.

You will demonstrate high technical acumen, solution design capability, and strong hands-on expertise in the development of technical solutions for complex business requirements. You will play leading role in providing the technical guidance to the team, best practices adoption, fostering collaborative & dynamic team built-up ensuring successful development and delivery of high-quality enterprise applications/systems.

Leading Team:

Partnership:

  • Active participation and contribution to PI, product & release planning etc.
  • Collaborate with onsite and offsite team members effectively.
Core Skills:
  • Java J2EE building web applications, spring technologies/frameworks (Spring Core, Spring MVC, Spring Cloud, Spring Boot) and tools.
  • Java, JEE & spring technologies/frameworks (Spring Core, Spring MVC, Spring Cloud, Spring Boot) and tools.
  • Experience with related frameworks and technologies (Hibernate, Restful services Spring JDBC, MVC etc.)
  • Strong experience with Microservices, Spring Boot / Spring framework, Rest API, JPA.
  • 2-10 years of experience in web development using HTML, CSS and JavaScript including ES2016+
  • Experience of REACT tools including React.js, Webpack, Redux and Flux
  • Experience with user interface design
  • Knowledge of unit testing frameworks like Mocha and Jest
  • Experience with browser based debugging and excellent troubleshooting skills
  • Knowledge on system architecture (N-Tire, Microservices, Cloud-native).
  • Strong knowledge of system design principles for scalable, high-performance, and extensible solutions for enterprise grade distributed and services systems.
  • Significant knowledge of Oracle PL/SQL and SQL.
  • Experience with Oracle Web logic, Tomcat to include installation, configuration, troubleshooting.
  • Working experience of Spring Boot application configuration, deployment and troubleshooting on server platforms Oracle Web logic/Tomcat/Cloud.
  • Experience with API management and Cloud-based platforms and services (AWS, Google).
  • Working knowledge of Dev-Ops: Git, Jenkins, CI/CD pipelines, etc.
  • Understanding of Test-Driven Development practices as well as Automation and Unit Testing.
  • Strong Analytical Skills.
  • Working knowledge on system observability/monitoring and alerting.
  • Experience Architecting and developing large scale Enterprise applications.
  • Proficient with software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies like Agile, Test- driven development.
  • Any experience in building applications for financial industry is a plus
Education:
  • Bachelor’s or higher degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in Engineering role.
  • 3+ Years experience as Engineering/Technical lead role.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated experience in delivering complex enterprise grade software solutions.

title: Spécialiste en santé, sécurité et environnement (SSE) (Poste sur le terrain)/EHS Specialist (Field Based)
description:
ERM recherche un·e spécialiste SSE (Santé, Sécurité et Environnement) d’expérience à Saint-Romuald, Canada, afin d’assumer un rôle de chef de file en environnement, santé et sécurité, et d’offrir un soutien technique sur le site du client.

Ce poste prévoit une combinaison de télétravail et de présence sur le terrain. Ce poste exige une personne experte en SSE hautement qualifiée, possédant une vaste expertise dans plusieurs disciplines SSE, capable de soutenir les opérations manufacturières, de maintenir la conformité réglementaire, de gérer les risques et de piloter des initiatives d’amélioration continue. Il s’agit d’un poste à temps partiel (24 heures par semaine) à durée déterminée de 6 mois, avec possibilité de prolongation.

La personne retenue agira à titre de personne-ressource de confiance auprès de la direction du site et des équipes opérationnelles, en offrant un soutien pratique, du coaching, de la formation, une supervision de la conformité et des conseils stratégiques en SSE. Ce rôle exige une présence régulière sur le site du client ainsi qu’une interaction active avec le personnel, les sous-traitants et la direction.

RESPONSABILITÉS

Conformité réglementaire et gestion des programmes SSE

  • Assurer la conformité aux exigences applicables en matière de santé, de sécurité et d’environnement aux niveaux fédéral, provincial et local, ainsi qu’aux exigences SSE de l’entreprise.
  • Gérer les politiques, procédures, permis, licences et documents requis en matière de SSE.
  • Maintenir les registres réglementaires et soutenir les activités de production de rapports de conformité.
  • Surveiller les changements réglementaires et veiller à la conformité du site aux exigences applicables.
  • Soutenir la mise en œuvre et l’amélioration continue des systèmes de gestion SSE.

Soutien aux opérations manufacturières et gestion des risques

  • Fournir un soutien SSE quotidien aux équipes de production, de maintenance, d’ingénierie et d’exploitation.
  • Réaliser des évaluations des risques, des analyses de risques liés aux tâches, des inspections de sécurité et des activités de réduction des dangers.
  • Évaluer les conditions de travail et cerner les occasions de réduire les risques et d’améliorer le rendement.
  • Élaborer, mettre en œuvre et améliorer les programmes SSE, notamment en matière de consignation et d’étiquetage (LOTO), de travaux à chaud, de protection contre les chutes, d’hygiène industrielle, de sécurité des sous-traitants et de gestion du changement (MOC).
  • Collaborer avec les équipes opérationnelles afin d’identifier et de traiter de façon proactive les risques SSE.

Enquêtes sur les incidents et gestion des mesures correctives

  • Enquêter sur les incidents, blessures, quasi-accidents et événements environnementaux.
  • Effectuer des analyses des causes fondamentales et déterminer les mesures correctives et préventives appropriées.
  • Assurer le suivi des mesures correctives jusqu’à leur mise en œuvre complète et en vérifier l’efficacité.
  • Diffuser les apprentissages découlant des incidents et les possibilités d’amélioration au personnel du site.

Formation, mobilisation et sécurité des entrepreneurs

  • Offrir de la formation SSE aux employés, au personnel de supervision et aux sous-traitants.
  • Animer des réunions de sécurité, des causeries de sécurité et des initiatives de mobilisation des employés.
  • Assurer l’accompagnement et le mentorat sur le terrain afin de renforcer la performance SSE.
  • Gérer les programmes de sécurité des sous-traitants et les processus de permis de travail.
  • Promouvoir une culture de santé et sécurité positive et proactive dans l’ensemble du site.

Audits, rapports et soutien à la direction

  • Réaliser des inspections et des audits des opérations de l’usine, des installations et des systèmes de gestion.
  • Surveiller les indicateurs SSE, le niveau de conformité et les initiatives d’amélioration.
  • Analyser les tendances de rendement et déterminer les possibilités d’amélioration continue.
  • Préparer des rapports, des présentations et des mises à jour sur la conformité à l’intention de la direction.
  • Fournir des recommandations et des conseils stratégiques en SSE à la direction du site.
  • Agir à titre de personne-ressource SSE de confiance auprès de la direction et des équipes opérationnelles.

QUALIFICATIONS

Expertise SSE

  • Expertise approfondie dans plusieurs disciplines liées à l’environnement, à la santé et à la sécurité.
  • Capacité à fournir des conseils techniques, des interprétations réglementaires et des solutions pratiques aux équipes opérationnelles.
  • Solide connaissance de la gestion des risques, des programmes de conformité et des systèmes de gestion SSE.

Présence sur le site

  • Une présence physique régulière à l’installation du client est requise.
  • Capacité à effectuer des observations sur le terrain, des inspections, des audits, des enquêtes sur les incidents et des activités de mobilisation des employés.

Exigence linguistique (site de Montréal seulement)

  • Les candidats appelés à soutenir les activités basées à Saint-Romuald doivent être en mesure de parler, lire et comprendre le français à un niveau professionnel.

EXIGENCES MINIMALES

  • Baccalauréat en sécurité, en santé au travail, en génie ou dans une discipline scientifique connexe, de préférence.
  • 5 à 10 ans d’expérience pertinente en SSE, de préférence dans les secteurs manufacturiers ou de la recherche et du développement.
  • Titre de Professionnel en sécurité agréé du Canada (PSAC) considéré comme un atout.
  • Expérience dans la réalisation d’évaluations des risques en santé et sécurité ainsi que dans la surveillance de l’hygiène industrielle.
  • Connaissance pratique des exigences réglementaires fédérales, provinciales et locales.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale, ainsi qu’une capacité éprouvée à communiquer efficacement.
  • Capacité à travailler de façon autonome et en équipe, sous orientation générale.
  • Solide éthique de travail et désir marqué d’apprendre, de se développer et de réussir.
  • Capacité à transformer des objectifs en plans d’action, à élaborer des échéanciers et à travailler de façon autonome ainsi qu’en équipe afin d’atteindre les objectifs.
  • Expérience démontrée à titre de spécialiste SSE principal(e).
  • Connaissance approfondie des réglementations et des normes SSE.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en analyse et en résolution de problèmes.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication et en leadership.

Transparence salariale :

Pour le poste de gestionnaire EHS, nous prévoyons une rémunération annuelle de base comprise entre 73100 $ CA et 94300 $ CA, soit 35,14 $ CA/heure à 45.33 $ CA/heure, pour un poste à durée déterminée et non exonéré. Dans certains cas, la rémunération d’un employé peut se situer à l’extérieur de cette fourchette selon les facteurs mentionnés ci-dessus. Ce poste pourrait être admissible à une prime de rendement (les employés occasionnels et les employés à durée déterminée/Flexforce ne sont pas admissibles aux primes).

Nous offrons un programme complet d’avantages sociaux comprenant notamment des congés payés, une assurance médicale, dentaire et de la vue, un régime d’épargne-retraite 401(k), ainsi qu’une assurance vie et invalidité aux employés admissibles aux avantages sociaux*.

*L’admissibilité aux avantages sociaux est limitée aux employés réguliers qui sont normalement affectés à 20 heures ou plus par semaine. Les employés à durée déterminée (y compris les employés Flexforce aux États-Unis seulement) qui sont régulièrement affectés à 20 heures ou plus par semaine sont admissibles à un ensemble limité d’avantages sociaux. Les employés occasionnels ne sont pas admissibles aux avantages sociaux. Veuillez consulter votre recruteur pour obtenir plus de détails.

À propos d’ERM

ERM est le plus grand cabinet mondial de conseil en développement durable. Nous collaborons avec les principales organisations internationales pour concevoir des solutions innovantes aux enjeux du développement durable, tout en créant des opportunités d’affaires qui répondent aux besoins actuels et préservent ceux des générations futures.

Nous croyons fermement que la diversité, l’équité et l’inclusion sont essentielles pour faire d’ERM un lieu de travail stimulant et épanouissant. Notre diversité constitue une force qui nous permet de proposer des solutions plus pertinentes à nos clients. Notre équipe mondiale d’experts aide les organisations à opérationnaliser leurs objectifs de développement durable, grâce à une expertise technique approfondie en environnement,

en aspects sociaux, en gestion des risques et en santé-sécurité. Cette approche intégrée, que nous appelons « boots to boardroom », nous permet de proposer des solutions stratégiques et techniques, tant sur le terrain qu’au niveau de la direction.

Veuillez soumettre votre curriculum vitae accompagné d’une brève lettre de motivation.

ERM accueille et encourage les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap. Des mesures d’accommodement peuvent être offertes sur demande à toutes les étapes du processus de sélection.

ERM is seeking an experienced EHS Specialist in St. Romuald, Quebec, Canada to provide environmental, health, and safety leadership and technical support at a client facility. This position is a combination of remote and onsite and requires a highly qualified EHS professional with broad expertise across multiple EHS disciplines who can support manufacturing operations, maintain regulatory compliance, manage risk, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. This is a part-time (24 hours/week) limited-term role for a duration of 6 months, extendable.

The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to site leadership and operational teams, providing hands-on support, coaching, training, compliance oversight, and strategic EHS guidance. This role requires regular physical presence at the client site and active engagement with employees, contractors, and management.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Regulatory Compliance & EHS Program Management

  • Ensure compliance with applicable country, province, and local health, safety, and environmental requirements, as well as company EHS requirements
  • Manage EHS policies, procedures, permits, licenses, and required documentation.
  • Maintain regulatory records and support compliance reporting activities.
  • Monitor regulatory changes and ensure site compliance with applicable requirements.
  • Support implementation and continuous improvement of EHS management systems.

Manufacturing Support & Risk Management

  • Provide daily EHS support to production, maintenance, engineering, and operations teams.
  • Conduct risk assessments, job hazard analyses, safety inspections, and hazard mitigation activities.
  • Evaluate workplace conditions and identify opportunities to reduce risk and improve performance.
  • Develop, implement, and improve EHS programs including Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), Hot Work, Fall Protection. Industrial Hygiene, Contractor Safety, Management of Change (MOC)
  • Partner with operational teams to proactively identify and address EHS risks.

Incident Investigation & Corrective Action Management

  • Investigate incidents, injuries, near misses, and environmental events.
  • Conduct root cause analyses and determine corrective and preventive actions.
  • Track corrective actions to closure and verify effectiveness.
  • Communicate lessons learned and improvement opportunities to site personnel.

Training, Engagement & Contractor Safety

  • Deliver EHS training to employees, supervisors, and contractors.
  • Facilitate safety meetings, toolbox talks, and employee engagement initiatives.
  • Provide field coaching and mentoring to strengthen EHS performance.
  • Manage contractor safety programs and permit-to-work processes.
  • Promote a positive and proactive safety culture across the facility.

Auditing, Reporting & Leadership Support

  • Conduct inspections and audits of plant operations, facilities, and management systems.
  • Monitor EHS metrics, compliance status, and improvement initiatives.
  • Analyze performance trends and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Prepare reports, presentations, and compliance updates for management.
  • Provide recommendations and strategic EHS guidance to site leadership.
  • Serve as a trusted EHS advisor to management and operational teams.

QUALIFICATIONS

EHS Expertise

  • Professional-level expertise across multiple environmental, health, and safety disciplines.
  • Ability to provide technical guidance, regulatory interpretation, and practical solutions to operational teams.
  • Strong knowledge of risk management, compliance programs, and EHS management systems.

On-Site Presence

  • Regular physical presence at the client facility is required.
  • Ability to conduct field observations, inspections, audits, incident investigations, and employee engagement activities.

Language Requirement Candidates must be able to speak, read, and understand French at a professional working level.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

  • B.Sc in Safety, Occupational Health, Engineering, or related science degree preferred.
  • 5-10 years relevant EHS experience with exposure to the manufacturing or research and development industries preferred.
  • CRSP preferred
  • Experience conducting health and safety risk assessments and industrial hygiene monitoring.
  • Working knowledge of federal, state, and local regulations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to communicate effectively.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team setting, with guidance and direction.
  • Strong work ethic with a passion to learn, grow, and thrive.
  • Ability to distill goals into plans, develop timelines, and work independently as well as part of a team, to achieve goals.
  • Proven experience as a Senior EHS Specialist.
  • In-depth knowledge of EHS regulations and standards.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and leadership abilities.

Pay Transparency:

We also may have instances where employee’s fall outside of the range based on the factors noted above. Who We Are:

As the largest global pure play sustainability consultancy, we partner with the world’s leading organizations, creating innovative solutions to sustainability challenges and unlocking commercial opportunities that meet the needs of today while preserving opportunity for future generations.

At ERM we know that creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive work environment is an essential part of making our company a great place to build a career. title: Cake Decorator
description:
As a member of the C&S Wholesale Grocers family of companies, SpartanNash is a food solutions company that delivers the ingredients for a better life. A distributor, wholesaler and retailer with a global supply chain network, SpartanNash distributes grocery and household goods, including fresh produce and the Our Family® portfolio of products, to locations in all 50 states.

Our braggingly happy team members — ranging from bakery managers to order selectors; from IT developers to vice presidents of finance; from HR Business Partners to export specialists — create braggingly happy customers spanning national accounts, independent and chain grocers, e-commerce retailers, U.S. military commissaries and exchanges, and the Company’s own brick-and-mortar grocery stores, pharmacies and fuel centers.

Ready to contribute to the success of our food solutions company? Apply now!

Location:

1341 N. M-52 - Owosso, Michigan 48867-1232

Position Summary:

This role is responsible to decorate cakes and other products; assist in other bakery duties; maintain and operate the bakery department in an efficient manner within company policy; to ensure that the shift contributes to the financial best interest of the store. Complete all other duties as assigned in a timely manner.

Here’s what you’ll do:

  • Decorate cakes, cookies, and other items as determined by production schedule and customer requests.

  • Baking and frying duties as assigned.

  • Price, date, wrap and/or bag bakery products.

  • Properly fill, rotate and merchandise bakery shelves, cases and displays.

  • Notify the Bakery Manager if products and supplies need to be ordered.

  • Handle spoiled/damaged products per established guidelines.

  • Assist in receiving, unloading and stocking of merchandise.

  • Have familiarity with all products carried in the department; know differences in price, taste, preparation, use etc.

  • Practice suggestive selling techniques with customers.

  • Maintain a clean, attractive and well stocked department.

  • Follow all PPE and Safety Guidelines

  • Follow all Food Safety and Cleaning Expectations

  • Follow Guest Experience Guidelines

  • May be assigned tasks in other departments

  • Additional responsibilities may be assigned as needed

Here’s what you’ll need:

  • High school diploma or GED preferred

  • Ability to read, write, comprehend, and interpret documents

  • Basic mathematical skills

  • Detail Oriented

Physical Requirements:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. May be required to lift and/or move up to 30 pounds frequently, and up to 50 pounds occasionally. The associate is required to stand and walk for extended periods of time and may bend, stoop, twist and turn frequently. While performing the duties of this position, the employee is subject to a typical retail store environment (varied temperatures) and is exposed to outside weather conditions. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate. Travel requirements vary by assignment.

As part of our People First culture, SpartanNash is proud to offer a robust and competitive Total Rewards benefits package.

SpartanNash is an Equal Opportunity Employer that invests in Associate development, recognizes and celebrates success, fosters two-way communication, and promotes a sense of belonging. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals, including those with disabilities and Veterans.

We are not able to sponsor work visas for this position.

title: Senior Agency Loan Processor (Multifamily Lending)
description:
About Us:

The Community Preservation Corporation (CPC) believes stable and sustainable affordable housing is the foundation of strong communities and we strive to contribute to comprehensive neighborhood revitalization through our lending and partnerships. A nationally recognized leader in affordable housing finance, CPC has provided a consistent source of capital to underserved housing markets throughout New York State since our inception in 1974.

Today, CPC stands as the largest CDFI solely committed to investing in multifamily housing, having invested more than $15 billion to finance the creation and preservation of more than 230,000 units of quality housing in neighborhoods across New York State and beyond. CPC has a robust construction lending platform, a mortgage bank, and equity and impact investment platforms that focus on our three goals: Expanding Affordable Housing, Closing the Racial Wealth Gap and Investing in the Green Economy.

As a member of our team, you'll have the opportunity to work on impactful projects that make a real difference in people's lives. We're looking for talented individuals who are passionate about our mission and share our values of commitment, respect, excellence, accountability, and collaboration.

About CPC Mortgage Company:

CPC Mortgage Company is CPC’s Agency lending subsidiary and is the only nonprofit-owned multifamily lender offering a suite of Freddie Mac, Fannie Mae, and Federal Housing Administration (FHA) multifamily mortgage products nationwide. Our products cover a range of borrower needs, from affordable, workforce, and conventional permanent mortgages to bridge and subordinate debt. Our team provides a unique blend of expertise that combines the trademark service and execution our borrowers value, with a focus on social impact through our investments in housing and communities.

Role Summary:

We're looking for a Senior Analyst, Processing (Agency) who will provide loan processing support for our team. You will work with Underwriting Analysts, Underwriters, and/or Freddie Mac/Fannie Mae and Originations team on setup of loan applications and submission of loan packages. The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple deals with competing deadlines.

What You’ll Do:

  • Independently coordinate and manage meetings, property site visits, due diligence activities, and key transaction milestones to support loan originations and underwriting efforts.

  • Assist in preparation, review, and submission of CPC applications, underwriting packages, Agency Multifamily loan processing documentation, and related materials, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance with program requirements.

  • Serve as a primary point of contact among Underwriters, Analysts, Originators, Agency Multifamily representatives, borrowers, and third-party vendors to drive transactions forward and proactively resolve issues.

  • Independently assess documentation requirements for new loan originations and ensure all underwriting package components are collected, reviewed, and submitted within established deadlines.

  • Manage and oversee outstanding items lists and due diligence tracking, proactively communicating with borrowers, sponsors, and internal stakeholders to ensure timely delivery of required documentation.

  • Maintain, validate, and reconcile information within agency, company, and loan origination systems, ensuring data integrity throughout the transaction lifecycle.

  • Partner closely with Underwriters and Originators to ensure complete submissions and the preparation of materials for internal and external approval processes.

  • Coordinate the ordering, monitoring, and distribution of third-party reports, ensuring timely delivery and resolution of issues that may impact underwriting or closing timelines.

  • Monitor changes to Freddie Mac, Fannie Mae, CPC, and other applicable program requirements and provide recommendations to enhance internal processes and controls.

  • Conduct comprehensive reviews of loan files to confirm completeness, identify potential submission concerns, and escalate material issues as appropriate.

  • Participate in special projects, process improvement initiatives, training efforts, and other strategic departmental objectives.

Skills and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of relevant multifamily real estate finance or loan processing experience preferred.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and multitasking skills.

  • Strong knowledge of Freddie Mac, Fannie Mae, affordable housing, and/or conventional multifamily lending programs, including documentation, underwriting, and closing requirements.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple complex transactions simultaneously while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively, taking ownership of processes and driving transactions from inception through closing with minimal oversight.

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook), Adobe Acrobat, and loan origination or underwriting systems.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation

  • 401(k) retirement plans with employer match

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for employees and their dependents

  • Commuter benefits

  • PTO for vacation, personal days, sick leave, holidays, jury duty, bereavement, parental leave, and disability

  • Tuition assistance program

  • Two “work from anywhere” weeks per year

  • Summer Fridays

  • Collaborative working spaces

  • Service days to support our communities

  • Employee development and engagement events

  • More about our offerings and culture here

This is a remote role available in Washington DC and Texas. Periodic travel to our Manhattan, NY office may be required. The salary range is $85,000 – $100,000, dependent on experience and market factors.

title: Product Analyst
description:
tl;dr Fresh off a $15M Series A led by Accel (total funding now $20M+), Agave is profitable, growing fast, and scaling the team. We're hiring a sharp, semi-technical generalist to become a deep product expert. You'll work directly with engineers to spec, test, and ship product improvements — rolling up your sleeves in the weeds of complex integrations, edge cases, and real customer data. This role is about execution, not strategy. You'll report directly to Product Managers. Learn more about us here (link).

What is Agave?

We're building the financial ops platform for construction, a $12T global industry run by software built 20-40 years ago, much of it on-prem with no APIs and no documentation.

We spent 3 years building the rails to read and write across those systems, and we use them to deploy AI for invoicing, expenses, compliance, billing, and more.

We have 550+ customers and have been profitable & cashflow positive for over two years. We're backed by Accel and Y Combinator, with investors from Procore, Autodesk, and Plaid. Our three co-founders have worked together for 12+ years, across Graphiq (acquired by Amazon in 2017) and Amazon.

We’ve built something people actually need, in a market most of Silicon Valley ignores — which is exactly why we’re winning. The only thing slowing us down is hiring. Our team is small, scrappy, and high-caliber, and we’re looking for the next wave of builders who will help take Agave from breakout startup to category-defining company.

Why are we hiring this role?

We're growing fast — 10% month-over-month — and our product surface is expanding rapidly. As we scale integrations and add new features, we need someone who can be the bridge between our engineering team and the messy reality of how customers actually use our product.

This person will own the investigative, speccing, QA, and rollout work that keeps our product moving quickly without sacrificing quality. You'll be embedded with engineers and will develop deep expertise in the systems we integrate with.

Responsibilities

Product Investigation & Spec

  • Become a deep expert on every system we integrate with — ERPs, field tools, accounting platforms

  • Investigate edge cases and unexpected behaviors in our integrations through structured debugging

  • Write precise, engineer-ready specs for new features, improvements, and bug fixes

  • Own the full lifecycle of features from discovery through QA and rollout

QA & Rollout

  • Design and execute thorough test plans before features ship

  • Catch edge cases that engineers and customers would miss

  • Document rollout steps and own post-launch monitoring

Customer & Internal Feedback Loops

  • Synthesize feedback from customer calls, support tickets, and onboarding observations

  • Translate implicit and explicit product pain points into actionable specs

  • Partner with the AM/onboarding team to identify friction points and prioritize fixes

Process & Documentation

  • Build internal documentation for integration behaviors, known edge cases, and common configurations

  • Create and maintain testing frameworks that scale as our product grows

  • Identify and improve gaps in our product development process

What we look for

  • Must have:

    • Hands-on: you'll be a full-time builder, not a manager. You must love operating in the messy weeds of nuanced systems, understanding their complexity and simplifying it for our customers. You will focus on product execution and delivery, less on strategy and market research.

    • Semi-technical: no need to code, but you must have at least internship experience working closely with APIs, databases, SQL, Postman, and similar tools OR excitement to learn. The more, the better.

    • Meticulous attention to detail: structured thinker who nerds-out on nuances, accounts for edge cases, and tests your work thoroughly before calling it done.

    • In-person: pumped to work in-person in SF 5 days per week.

  • Nice to have:

  • Experience building software products alongside software engineers and shipping products on tight timelines.

This role may be a great fit if….

  • You aren’t a developer, but you’ve built side projects/hustles. You will get more of a chance to flex your technical acumen here than in most product roles, often working side-by-side with engineers.

  • You like tinkering. The systems we integrate with are old, challenging, and sometimes unpredictable. If you enjoy discovering through trial and error in a sandbox, you’ll fit right in.

  • You’re good at puzzles, complex turn-based games, etc - Construction project financials are a large dependency stack with many variables. If you manage complex systems well, you’ll likely pick it up quickly.

  • You want to learn how software products get built. You will work with an extremely high-performing team that knows how to build great technology and products.

This role may NOT be for you if...

  • You want to be a product strategist or “CEO of the Product”. This role is about execution. Expect ~80% of your time spent on technical investigation, feature specs, QA, and rollout. If you want to own a roadmap and run discovery sprints, this isn't the right fit right now.

  • You prefer narrow, well-defined responsibilities. The scope here will evolve as we grow. You'll wear many hats and figure things out with limited direction.

  • You want a slow ramp. In your first week, you'll produce research docs that are ready for engineering to implement. We’ll expect you to quickly become an expert on the systems we integrate with, and every inch of our products. Naturally, this gives you outsized potential for growth.

  • You want a primarily customer-facing role. While you will interface with customers, this role will primarily focus on working internally with our product and dev teams.

  • You prefer remote work. We're in-person in San Francisco 5 days/week

Benefits

  • Healthcare: we cover 90% of your healthcare costs with several plan options.

  • 401k: we match 100% of your contributions, up to 4% of annual salary.

  • Performance Bonuses: we offer annual performance bonuses when we hit company growth goals, which are a % of your base salary. These are large, meaningful rewards that scale with the amount we grow in a particular year.

  • Relocation: sizable relocation bonus for folks currently located outside of the Bay Area, and a bonus for anyone (even within the Bay Area) who moves within a 15-minute walk of our office.

  • Breakfast & Dinner, delivered: breakfast and dinner stipends through DoorDash. Plus a kitchen stocked with coffee, snacks, drinks, and more.

  • Gym: on-site gym with Peloton, squat rack, Tempo, Yoga setup, and more.

  • Visa: we sponsor Visas (H1B, TN, etc.) for candidates who are a good fit!

  • Commuter benefits: employees can make pre-tax contributions toward commuting costs, and we'll cover the full cost of a Muni pass for those using public transit.

In-Person

  • We've built Agave in-person since day 1, and will maintain an in-person culture in San Francisco going forward. We form tighter bonds, build a stronger culture, and move faster since we're all working from one location.

  • Our office is at 101 New Montgomery Street, San Francisco, right near Salesforce Park, coffee shops & restaurants, and a bustling downtown. We believe building in-person is a huge strategic advantage, and we hope you’ll join us.

About the interview process

  1. Intro (15min): informal chat for you to learn more about the role. We'll ask for details on your past projects and what you're looking for next. We want to know that you meet our basic requirements and can speak about your work clearly. You’re welcome to ask lots of questions about whether working at Agave makes sense for you.

  2. Writing Exercise (45min): we provide two short prompts that you reply to in a Google Doc. Our goal is to quickly decide whether you understand our business and can write clearly, with minimum time required from you.

  3. Experience (30min): we'll dive into the details of your recent work experience, asking questions to learn about what you've done. Our goal is to ensure you've worked on sufficiently complex projects to confirm you'll be successful if you join us full-time. We'll also reserve time to answer any questions you have about Agave.

  4. Case Study: longer form, written exercise that will assess your ability to succeed in the role.

  5. On-site (60min x 5, all 1:1 interviews) [In-Person in SF, we pay for the trip]: you'll interview with each co-founder and other members of our team. This will be a deeper dive into your experience and overall fit. Each interview is about 1hr, 45min for our questions and 15min for yours.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
About the Role

Join a growing engineering team at a Munich-based AI platform and product studio building the core infrastructure that enables thousands of users to interact with AI every day. You'll work across the full stack to deliver reliable, secure, and performant features — from synchronizing large client datasets and running massive LLM workloads to supporting rapid custom integrations.

This is a hybrid role based in Munich, Germany, offering meaningful product ownership and the opportunity to shape how businesses adopt and leverage AI.

What You'll Do

  • Build and ship high-quality full-stack features using TypeScript and React, with a focus on seamless user experience.

  • Design and implement robust backend systems capable of handling massive data scale and millions of API requests.

  • Take full end-to-end ownership of features — from concept and development through deployment and ongoing operation.

  • Debug production incidents, identify root causes, and implement lasting solutions.

  • Mentor junior engineers and raise the bar through thorough, constructive code reviews.

  • Synchronize and index terabytes of client data while enforcing fine-grained permissions.

  • Operate and optimize systems that process millions of LLM calls per month with high reliability.

  • Architect and scale environments that spawn thousands of secure code sandboxes per day.

  • Build foundational infrastructure that enables the integrations team to onboard new systems quickly.

  • Collaborate on AI integrations to shape how users interact with the platform.

What We're Looking For

Required (dealbreakers):

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience delivering full-stack features using React, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL in Dockerized environments with CI/CD pipelines.

  • Experience with Kubernetes-based deployment and container orchestration.

  • Proven track record delivering production-grade backend services at scale — high data volume, millions of API requests, with a strong focus on reliability and security.

Strong plus:

  • Experience with backend frameworks such as Python, tRPC, or similar technologies.

  • Hands-on experience with GenAI platforms or LLM integrations.

  • Experience mentoring junior engineers and leading code reviews.

  • Comfortable thriving in a fast-paced, high-growth product environment.

Location & Work Arrangement

  • Location: Munich, Germany

  • Work style: Hybrid (on-site presence in Munich required)

  • Visa sponsorship: Not available — candidates must have the right to work in Germany

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary range: €60,000 – €80,000 per year (or equivalent), depending on experience

  • Full-time position with meaningful ownership of your work

  • Opportunity to work at the intersection of product engineering and applied AI

  • Collaborative team environment with experienced engineers from top-tier technology and research organizations

title: Montagemedarbejder søges til teknisk montage
description:
Stillingen indebærer arbejde i en struktureret produktion, hvor du indgår i en fast proces med samling af enheder. Arbejdet foregår ved en station eller linje, hvor opgaverne er opdelt i klare trin, så alle bidrager til det samlede flow. Du vil få en grundig introduktion til opgaverne, så du hurtigt kan arbejde selvstændigt inden for de fastsatte rammer.

Hverdagen er præget af gentagende opgaver, hvor det handler om at opretholde en stabil kvalitet gennem hele arbejdsdagen. Der er fokus på, at alle trin udføres korrekt, og at eventuelle afvigelser opdages i tide. Du bliver en del af et team, hvor samarbejde og ansvarlighed er afgørende for, at produktionen fungerer effektivt.

Der er tale om et job, hvor man hurtigt finder en rytme i arbejdet, og hvor tydelige forventninger gør det nemt at lykkes i rollen.


Arbejdsopgaver
  • Samle komponenter i en fast rækkefølge efter instruktioner
  • Sikre at alle dele passer korrekt sammen og lever op til kravene
  • Udføre løbende kontrol af eget arbejde for at sikre ensartet kvalitet
  • Håndtere mindre justeringer undervejs i processen
  • Sørge for, at arbejdsstationen er ryddelig og klar til næste opgave
  • Bidrage til et jævnt og stabilt produktionsflow
  • Samarbejde med kolleger omkring opgaver og tempo
  • Reagere på fejl eller afvigelser og give besked ved behov



Faglige Kvalifikationer
  • Erfaring fra produktion/montage er en fordel
  • Du har forståelse for at arbejde efter faste procedurer og instruktioner
  • Du kan arbejde systematisk og holde overblik over dine opgaver
  • Du har øje for detaljer og kan arbejde med præcision
  • Du er vant til, eller motiveret for, praktisk arbejde, hvor hænderne er i brug
  • Du kan arbejde i et miljø, hvor tempo og kvalitet følges tæt



Personlige kvalifikationer
  • Du er mødestabil og tager ansvar for din arbejdsdag
  • Du trives med rutineprægede opgaver og finder motivation i at gøre tingene korrekt
  • Du arbejder koncentreret og bevarer fokus – også ved gentagelser
  • Du er samarbejdsvillig og bidrager til en god stemning på arbejdspladsen
  • Du er fleksibel i forhold til opgaver og tempo
  • Du har en positiv tilgang og er indstillet på at lære nye arbejdsprocesser



Særlige forhold
  • Arbejdet foregår i en produktionsvirksomhed med faste rammer og procedurer
  • Oplæring sker ved opstart, og du vil blive introduceret til opgaverne trin for trin
  • Arbejdet kan være stående og indebærer gentagende bevægelser i løbet af dagen
  • Der stilles krav til både kvalitet og effektivitet, som følges løbende
  • Arbejdsmiljøet er struktureret med fokus på sikkerhed og orden

Construction Inspector Senior-2

Technical Services

title: Operations  NPI Project Manager
description:
Summary:

VIAVI (NASDAQ: VIAV) is a global provider of network test, monitoring and assurance solutions for telecommunications, cloud, enterprises, first responders, military, aerospace, and railway. VIAVI is also a leader in light management technologies for 3D sensing, anti-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, industrial, automotive, government and aerospace applications.

We are the people behind the products that help keep the world connected at home, school, work, at play, and everywhere in between. VIAVI employees are passionate about supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company – to question, to collaborate and to push for solutions that will delight our customers.

Duties & Responsibilities:

New Product Introduction (Ops NPI) Project Manager

Summary
The Ops NPI Project Manager will lead cross-functional Operations teams in the planning and execution of new product introductions — with an initial focus on Tips and Adaptors (T&A), the fiber optic interface accessories that connect diverse cable and connector types to VIAVI test instruments — ensuring a smooth and successful transition from design engineering to full-scale production at either a VIAVI owned factory or the factory of a contract manufacturing (CM) partner.

This role serves as the central Operations point of contact for all product launch activities, managing timelines, budgets, and risks to meet strategic business objectives focusing on schedule, quality, delivery, and cost. This role requires close collaboration across four R&D teams in the United States (Bothell, WA and Indianapolis, IN), Canada (Ottawa), and France (St. Etienne), as well as T&A contract manufacturers in China and Thailand.

Essential duties and responsibilities

Project management: Lead the Operations elements of the NPI process from project initiation through production launch, first customer shipment, and into volume production.

  • Represent Operations on the cross functional NPI project team
  • Drive integrated project planning to establish work commitments and dependencies between Operations and other functions
  • Lead the Operations team to execute to the requirements of the Product Development Process (PDP), including functional deliverables to support project goals
  • Drive Operations execution to plan including:
    • Alignment and documentation of project goals and metrics
    • Project resourcing
    • Management of work commitments across the Operations team, ensuring required deliverables are completed on time
    • Project expense (capital and operational) forecasting and performance to plan
    • Capacity planning and production ramp planning

Cross-functional collaboration: Coordinate and manage a diverse operations team, including test engineering, manufacturing engineering, and supply chain; coordinate requirements and deliverables across four geographically dispersed R&D teams (Bothell, Indianapolis, Ottawa, St. Etienne), the extended internal team (product line management, service, finance, etc.), and external T&A manufacturing partners in China and Thailand.

Process and tool alignment: Evaluate and drive convergence of NPI tracking and requirements management across all four R&D sites — currently split between Jira (Bothell) and VIAVI's standard Product Development Process (Indianapolis, Ottawa, St. Etienne) — to a single unified tool, a standardized PDP instance, or an agreed hybrid solution.

Manufacturing launch and production ramp: Ensure manufacturing requirements for production launch and ramp, at either a VIAVI or a CM factory, are met during the NPI process.

  • DFx and Supply Chain reviews are executed at appropriate phase of the NPI process
  • Drive Supply Chain and manufacturing process development concurrently with product development
  • Manufacturing process development is complete and validated prior to pilot build

Risk management: Proactively identify project risks, develop mitigation strategies, and resolve issues that arise during the NPI process to keep projects on track.

Stakeholder communication: Provide clear and regular communication to stakeholders and senior leadership on project status, progress against milestones, and resource utilization.

Continuous improvement: Conduct post-mortem analysis of completed projects to identify lessons learned and drive continuous improvement in NPI processes and tools.

Technical knowledge: Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, engineering design, and product lifecycle management.

Methodology proficiency: Experience with project management tools and methodologies (e.g., Phase-Gate, Lean, Agile).

Pre-Requisites / Skills / Experience Requirements:

Experience:

  • 5 years of project management leading teams to achieve aggressive cost, quality, and schedule targets

  • 5 years of NPI project management experience in a cross functional environment (R&D, Operations, PLM, Service, etc.)

  • Experience managing teams across multiple countries and continents, including coordination across North American and European time zones and cultures

  • Strong understanding of the CM environment through direct experience managing CM operations or through successful transfer of products into a CM

  • Working knowledge of Jira and phase-gate product development processes; experience evaluating, selecting, or harmonizing project management tools across distributed teams

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field.

Preferred qualifications

PMP or other project management certification.

Professional qualification in Risk Management, Six Sigma, Lean, CPI

Familiarity with enterprise resource planning (ERP) software.

Experience in fiber optics, test and measurement, or a related photonics field.

If you have what it takes to push boundaries and seize opportunities, apply to join our team today.

VIAVI Solutions is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer – minorities/females/veterans/persons with disabilities.

Job Posting Pay Range:

103,600

to

192,400

Exceptional qualifications, experience and location may impact salary. VIAVI offers a competitive benefits package that includes paid time off, health, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and a bonus program.

title: Quality Engineer
description:
Company:

Marsh Corporate

Description:

We are looking for a visionary, forward-thinking Quality Engineer who views quality holistically and can drive a Quality Engineering throughout the POD.

This role will be based in Cluj Napoca. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.


As Quality Engineer you will work across multiple teams to embed “shift-left” quality principles, build a scalable test automation approach aligned to the testing pyramid, and continuously improve quality, velocity, and efficiency.

You will bring a strong understanding of industry trends across tools, methods, and practices—and you’ll help implement them where they add value. This role requires a team player with strong leadership skills, the ability to influence stakeholders, and a proven track record delivering enterprise-scale test programs.

We will count on you to:

  • Lead and manage end-to-end testing and quality engineering delivery across enterprise-scale applications/projects

  • Establish and drive a shift-left quality strategy across squads/teams, ensuring consistent adoption of best practices.

  • Own and co-create a test approach to deliver the Test Strategy, including functional and non-functional testing

  • Drive innovation and continuous improvement in tooling, automation, and test practices—aligned to testing pyramid principles

  • Propose strategies to increase adoption of new tools/technologies that improve testing efficiency and effectiveness

  • Manage testing initiatives from requirements analysis through test strategy, planning, design, execution coordination, documentation, and reporting

  • Mentor and consult with module leads and test leads on test strategy, planning, and test practices

  • Review and validate requirements for different testing phases, ensuring quality deliverables and readiness for each release stage.

  • Provide leadership with meaningful quality insights, including:

title: Engineer Elektra
description:
---In verband met de vakantieperiode kunnen wij je op dit moment nog geen inhoudelijke terugkoppeling geven. In week 34/35 ontvang je bericht over het verdere verloop van je sollicitatie.---

De energietransitie is onmogelijk zonder jou als Engineer Elektra

Je werkt in een projectteam aan het ontwerp, de voorbereiding en de realisatie van onze projecten. Je bouwt mee aan uiteenlopende infraprojecten met maatschappelijke impact. Zoals de realisatie van een woon- en kantoortoren die aangesloten moet worden op het elektriciteitsnetwerk. Of de verbreding van een snelweg waarbij de kabels- en leidingen moeten worden verlegd. Maar ook een zonnepark die op het bestaande energienet moeten worden aangesloten. Op basis van de eisen realiseer jij een ontwerp voor deze projecten. Het energienet van de toekomst maken we voor iedereen, mét iedereen. En als engineer werk jij hieraan mee. Zo ben jij bezig met het:

  • analyseren van aanvraaggegevens van de projecten.
  • bepalen van de aanpak door berekeningen uit te voeren en op locatie de situatie in beeld te brengen.
  • maken van en aanvragen van de benodigde documentatie, zoals verkeersplannen, vergunningen, en asbest- en bodemonderzoek.
  • bestellen van de benodigde materialen en berekenen van de verwachte kosten.
  • overleggen met interne ketenpartners en externe partijen over de plannen die je hebt gemaakt.

Jij maakt het net completer bij Alliander

Wist je dat we bij Alliander uit verschillende bedrijven bestaan? Met een grote club vakmensen ontwikkelen en beheren we het energienet voor miljoenen inwoners en ondernemers van Nederland. Dit doen we samen en met aandacht voor onze klant. En dankzij onze talenten hebben wij het volste vertrouwen in de energietoekomst van Nederland. Samen met jou maken wij de energietransitie mogelijk.

En jij gaat dat doen bij ons bedrijfsonderdeel Liander. Hier ben jij medeverantwoordelijk voor het beheer en onderhoud van energienetten zoals elektriciteit en gas. Zo leveren wij energie aan huishoudens, bedrijven en andere klanten.

Slimme ontwerpen maken kan alleen als jij genoeg energie hebt. En de juiste werkomgeving geeft jou dat. Het moet dus wat opleveren. De afdeling in Duiven bestaat uit gezellige en kundige collega’s. Je werkt samen met de uitvoerders en projectmanagers aan een hetzelfde doel. Daarbij steunen jullie elkaar waar het kan. Jouw toekomstige collega vertelt hier meer over.

"Omdat je van A-Z betrokken bent bij de projecten, heb je echt de kans om je creativiteit en talenten in te zetten. Dit in samenwerking met een warm en fijn team"

Jij maakt het net energieker

Het beheren en ontwerpen van ons elektriciteits- of gasnet. Dat doe je vanuit je eigen kracht en talent. En dat doe je bij ons. Draag jij daaraan bij met jouw logische manier van denken? Geweldig! Zeker als je dit aanvult met:

  • minimaal een mbo 4-diploma, bij voorkeur in de richting energietechniek, elektrotechniek, werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbaar.
  • kennis van ondergrondse infrastructuren, kabels of middenspanningsstations werkt in je voordeel. Als je hier nog geen ervaring mee hebt, krijg je bij ons de kans deze op te doen.
  • bij voorkeur ervaring met SAP en GAIA.
  • ervaring met projectmatig werken.

Voor jou net beter geregeld

Daarvoor krijg jij op basis van een 40-urige werkweek:

  • een salaris van € 3.729 tot €5.328 bruto per maand (schaal 7)

  • jaarlijks een individueel keuze budget (IKB) van 18% (fulltime) of 12,8% (parttime) van je bruto jaarsalaris. Dit is inclusief 8% vakantietoeslag. Je kunt dit bedrag uit laten betalen, maar je kunt er bijvoorbeeld ook extra vrije dagen voor kopen. Jij kiest wat bij jou past.
  • 24,5 vakantiedagen per jaar, ruim aan te vullen vanuit je IKB.
  • een eindejaarsuitkering in december van 6% van je jaarsalaris
  • Elk jaar een DI-budget van € 700,- voor jouw duurzame inzetbaarheid. Kies bijvoorbeeld voor een vergoeding van jouw sport op hobby, verduurzaming en vergroening van je huis, of het verlichten van je studieschuld bij DUO. Jij bepaalt waar jouw budget naartoe gaat.

Natuurlijk hebben we nog veel meer! Lees meer over al jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Voor jou net wat meer informatie

Samen maken we het net beter. Voor iedereen, met iedereen. En daar hoor jij bij! Solliciteer op deze vacature en binnen 5 werkdagen krijg je een reactie van ons.

Een assessment of screening kan onderdeel uitmaken van jouw sollicitatieprocedure. In onze screeningsvoorwaarden vind je meer informatie. Meer weten over de functie-inhoud? Robin Kok, corporate recruiter vertelt je hier meer over via robin.kok@alliander.com of 06-42 92 87 43.

As a Monitor Tech at MUSC, you will play a crucial role in monitoring and interpreting cardiac rhythms for patients in various healthcare settings. Your responsibilities will include observing cardiac monitors, recognizing abnormal rhythms, and promptly alerting healthcare professionals to any changes in patient status. With your vigilance and attention to detail, you will help ensure the safety and well-being of our patients.

Job Description


Job Description

Summary: As a Monitor Tech at MUSC, you will play a crucial role in monitoring and interpreting cardiac rhythms for patients in various healthcare settings. Your responsibilities will include observing cardiac monitors, recognizing abnormal rhythms, and promptly alerting healthcare professionals to any changes in patient status. With your vigilance and attention to detail, you will help ensure the safety and well-being of our patients.

Key Responsibilities:

Monitor Cardiac Rhythms: Watch cardiac monitors continuously to observe patients' heart rhythms and detect any irregularities or abnormalities.

Recognize Alarms: Quickly recognize and respond to monitor alarms indicating changes in heart rate, rhythm, or other cardiac parameters.

Notify Healthcare Team: Alert nurses, physicians, or other healthcare providers immediately when abnormal rhythms or significant changes in patient status are detected.

Document Observations: Record and document cardiac rhythms, alarm events, and interventions accurately and in a timely manner in the patient's medical records.

Maintain Equipment: Ensure proper functioning of cardiac monitoring equipment by performing regular checks, troubleshooting technical issues, and reporting malfunctions promptly.

Communicate Effectively: Communicate clearly and effectively with members of the healthcare team, providing concise and accurate information about patients' cardiac status.

Patient Advocacy: Advocate for patient safety and well-being by promptly addressing any concerns or issues related to cardiac monitoring and reporting them to the appropriate personnel.

Collaborate with Team: Collaborate with nurses, physicians, and other healthcare professionals to coordinate patient care and facilitate timely interventions as needed.

Follow Protocols: Adhere to hospital policies, procedures, and protocols related to cardiac monitoring, patient safety, and confidentiality.

Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; additional education or certification in cardiac monitoring or healthcare-related field preferred.

  • Previous experience as a Monitor Tech or similar role in a healthcare setting is advantageous.

  • Familiarity with cardiac rhythms and ability to recognize common arrhythmias is highly desirable.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to focus for extended periods while monitoring multiple patients simultaneously.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact professionally with patients and healthcare team members.

  • Ability to remain calm and composed in high-pressure situations and respond quickly to emergent situations.

  • Basic computer skills for data entry and documentation purposes.

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to sit for extended periods while monitoring cardiac monitors and performing related tasks.

  • Manual dexterity and hand-eye coordination to operate monitor controls and navigate computer systems.

  • Visual acuity to accurately read and interpret cardiac rhythms displayed on monitors.

  • Emotional resilience and ability to cope with stress and uncertainty inherent in healthcare environments.

Additional Job Description

Minimum Requirements: At least 1 year in a .6fte or greater Monitor Technician I position at MUSC or 1 year of Monitor Technician/Telemetry work experience in a health care facility and succeful completion of the EKG training/competency during the orientation period in order to remain in the Monitor Technician II position. Credentials: Basic Life Support required within 2 weeks of hire. Thereafter, must maintain. Current American Heart Association (AHA) Basic Life Support (BLS) certification or American Red Cross BLS for Healthcare Providers certification is required.

If you like working with energetic enthusiastic individuals, you will enjoy your career with us!

title: Senior Cybersecurity Engineer (Azure and GRC heavy)
description:
Hyliion is committed to creating innovative solutions that enable clean, flexible and affordable electricity production. The Company’s primary focus is to develop distributed power generators that can operate on various fuel sources to future-proof against an ever-changing energy economy.

Job Purpose

The Senior Cybersecurity Engineer owns Hyliion’s overall day-to-day cybersecurity operations — endpoint security, identity and Conditional Access, cloud/SaaS security posture, and AI governance — across a cloud-native, Microsoft-centric technology environment. This includes maintaining the System Security Plan (SSP) and control set for Hyliion’s CMMC Level 2 certified enclave, sustaining NIST 800-171 compliance . Beyond the enclave, the role administers Microsoft Entra ID Conditional Access, the Microsoft Defender suite, endpoint management (patching, EDR, and device compliance), our Red Canary Managed Detection and Response (MDR) partnership, and the security and governance of our growing SaaS and enterprise AI footprint across the broader organization.

AI at Hyliion

At Hyliion, AI is core to how we work. We equip every team member with leading AI tools and count on you to use them — to move faster, solve harder problems, and help us realize the full potential of KARNO technology for the world.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Own and maintain Hyliion’s overall day-to-day cybersecurity posture across the enterprise, spanning identity, endpoint, cloud/SaaS, and AI governance.
  • Maintain the System Security Plan (SSP) and control implementation for Hyliion’s CMMC Level 2 (C3PAO)-certified enclave, sustaining NIST 800-171 compliance and annual affirmation in SPRS for that defined scope.
  • Administer and continuously optimize Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) Conditional Access policies, identity protection, and Privileged Identity Management (PIM) to enforce least-privilege and zero-trust principles.
  • Own endpoint security end-to-end — patch management, vulnerability remediation, EDR fleet health, and compliance baselines across Windows, macOS, and mobile endpoints — using Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and Intune.
  • Manage the broader Microsoft Defender suite (Defender for Office 365, Defender for Cloud Apps, Defender for Identity), including policy tuning, alert triage, and threat response.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for the Red Canary Managed Detection and Response (MDR) partnership, coordinating incident escalations, tuning detections, and reviewing threat intelligence reports.
  • Administer Mobile Device Management (MDM)/Intune enrollment, compliance policies, and configuration across corporate and BYOD devices.
  • Own security posture and governance across Hyliion’s growing SaaS application footprint (SaaS Security Posture Management), including OAuth/app permission reviews, shadow IT discovery, and third-party app risk assessment.
  • Govern the secure and compliant use of enterprise AI platforms — monitoring usage, enforcing acceptable-use and data-handling policies, assessing AI vendor risk, and identifying unsanctioned (“shadow AI”) tool adoption.
  • Monitor, triage, and respond to day-to-day cybersecurity incidents and alerts, ensuring timely containment, remediation, and documentation.
  • Maintain and update security policies, procedures, and control documentation supporting NIST 800-171, CMMC, SOX IT general controls, and other applicable frameworks.
  • Support recurring internal and third-party audits, evidence collection, and control testing, including SOX ITGC, CMMC annual affirmation, and cyber insurance renewal questionnaires.
  • Partner with business leaders across departments to assess and mitigate information security risk in new projects, vendor relationships, SaaS adoption, and AI tool deployments.
  • Maintain and enhance the executive-level cybersecurity dashboard and reporting cadence, translating technical risk into business-relevant metrics for leadership and the Board Audit Committee.
  • Contribute to and maintain the company’s incident response, business continuity, and disaster recovery plans, participating in periodic tabletop exercises.
  • Stay current on emerging threats and regulatory changes — including AI/LLM-specific risks (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLM applications, data leakage, prompt injection) and DFARS/CMMC/NIST developments — and recommend proactive improvements.
  • Additional duties and responsibilities as assigned, needed, or required for the business.

Qualifications

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Qualifications include:

  • Education, Experience and Certifications
    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
    • 5+ years of IT experience with a focus on cybersecurity operations and compliance.
    • CISSP, CISM, Security+, Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500), Microsoft SC-200, or other relevant security certification preferred.
  • Skills and Abilities
    • Hands-on administration experience with Microsoft Azure/Entra ID, including Conditional Access, Identity Protection, and Privileged Identity Management (PIM).
    • Experience with endpoint security operations — patch management, vulnerability remediation, and EDR administration (Microsoft Defender for Endpoint or equivalent).
    • Experience managing the Microsoft Defender suite and Microsoft Purview/Compliance Center.
    • Experience working with a Managed Detection and Response (MDR) provider (e.g., Red Canary, CrowdStrike), including alert triage and incident response coordination.
    • Experience administering MDM/Intune for endpoint compliance and device management.
    • Familiarity with SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) or CASB concepts and experience securing a cloud-native, SaaS-first technology environment.
    • Familiarity with AI/LLM security considerations (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, data leakage prevention, shadow AI risk) and experience governing enterprise AI tool usage (e.g., Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT Enterprise).
    • Working knowledge of NIST 800-171, CMMC 2.0, DFARS, SOX IT general controls, or similar regulatory/compliance frameworks.
    • Ability to handle multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
    • Ability to work well under minimal supervision.
    • Manufacturing industry experience (preferred).
    • Additional duties and responsibilities as assigned, needed, or required for the business.

Role Classification and Working Conditions

This is a salaried, exempt-level position. This position typically works in an office environment; and given the nature of our business is also exposed to operations/warehouses/production environments.

****Sponsorship is not available for this role****

  • Short Term Disability, paid for by the company
  • Long Term Disability, paid for by the company

  • Health Savings Account (HSA)

  • Voluntary Accident Plans

title: Pricing Architect
description:
About the Role

We're an early-stage AI-powered pricing optimization SaaS startup helping B2B companies turn pricing from a static exercise into a continuously improving, data-driven system. Our platform spans the full pricing lifecycle — from packaging and price architecture to deal execution and sales coaching — and we're growing fast.

We're looking for a Pricing Architect based in Amsterdam to own high-impact pricing engagements with our customers end-to-end. This is a senior, client-facing role at the intersection of commercial strategy, AI, and SaaS monetization. You'll work directly with C-suite stakeholders and cross-functional teams to design and deliver pricing strategies that drive real revenue outcomes.

What You'll Do

  • Lead customer pricing engagements independently — from initial discovery through to a live pricing and proposition model.

  • Design segmentation frameworks, packaging structures, price metrics, and monetization logic tailored to each customer's business context.

  • Apply advanced pricing methods including willingness-to-pay analysis, price elasticity modeling, discount architecture, and usage-based or consumption pricing.

  • Present findings and recommendations confidently to C-level executives and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Leverage AI and GenAI/LLM tools actively in your day-to-day work to accelerate analysis and insight generation.

  • Use data (spreadsheets, SQL) to dig into pricing analysis and support evidence-based recommendations.

  • Coach and mentor colleagues, sharing pricing expertise across the team.

What We're Looking For

Must-haves:

  • 5–7+ years of experience in pricing, commercial strategy, or revenue management — from a Tier 1 strategy consulting background or a pricing/revenue role within a tech or SaaS company.

  • Deep expertise in pricing and commercial value creation: segmentation, packaging, price metrics, discounting, and willingness-to-pay methodologies.

  • Strong client-facing skills; comfortable owning engagements and building credibility with C-level and cross-functional audiences.

  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI and confidence in steering AI-driven work (no need to build models yourself).

  • Hands-on use of GenAI/LLM tools in your current workflow.

  • Solid data skills — proficient with spreadsheets and SQL for pricing analysis.

  • Professional fluency in English.

  • Must be authorized to work in the Netherlands — visa sponsorship is not available.

Nice to have:

  • Experience coaching or mentoring junior team members.

  • Background in SaaS monetization models (usage-based, seat-based, hybrid, outcome-based).

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

  • Meaningful equity through an Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP).

Location

This is an on-site role based in Amsterdam, Netherlands. Candidates must be based in or willing to relocate to Amsterdam. No visa sponsorship is available — you must already be authorized to work in the Netherlands.

The Vascular Access Registered Nurse is responsible for the assessment, insertion and monitoring of Peripherally Inserted Central Catheter (PICC), Midline Catheter, Peripheral IV Catheters and other venous access devices inserted with and without the use of ultrasound guidance with minimal supervision, under the order of a Licensed Independent Practitioner and in accordance with the state Nurse Practice Act and hospital/department policies. Responsibility also includes coordinating the process of PICC Line/Midline placements, communication with primary care nurse and providing education for care and maintenance of vascular access devices. The Vascular Access RN directs the PICC line process and team member, establishing a positive and professional rapport with other departments and staff focusing on the provision on individualized quality patient care consistent with organizational standards and goals.

title: Lead Data Analyst
description:
Lead Data Analyst

Role Purpose

The Data Analyst will support assessment activities through data discovery, profiling, classification, documentation, and stakeholder engagement. The role serves as the bridge between business, architecture, governance, and technical teams.

Job Summary

The Data Analyst is responsible for identifying where sensitive data exists, understanding how it is used, documenting findings, supporting classification exercises, and validating recommendations. The role will perform detailed analysis of data elements, APIs, interfaces, reports, and downstream systems to provide evidence-based recommendations for governance and remediation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct data discovery and profiling activities.
  • Support data classification exercises.
  • Analyze source and destination data flows.
  • Identify sensitive data exposure points.
  • Document current-state processes and findings.
  • Support data lineage creation.
  • Facilitate stakeholder workshops.
  • Validate business and technical assumptions.
  • Prepare reports, inventories, and assessments.
  • Support roadmap and recommendation development.

Required Technical Skills

  • Data Analysis
  • SQL
  • Data Profiling
  • Data Mapping
  • Data Quality Assessment
  • Data Lineage Documentation
  • Excel & Reporting Tools
  • Metadata Analysis
  • Business Analysis

Preferred Skills

  • Data Governance
  • Privacy Assessment Support
  • Data Catalog Tools
  • Reporting & Visualization Tools
  • Requirements Management

Experience Required

  • 5+ years in Data Analysis, Data Governance, or Business Analysis.
  • Experience with data assessment or governance programs.
  • Experience working with business and technical stakeholders.

Education & Preferred Certifications

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or related field.

Preferred Certifications

  • CBAP
  • CCBA
  • CDMP (Associate)
  • Data Governance Certifications

Key Deliverables

  • Data Inventory
  • Data Classification Matrix
  • Data Mapping Documentation
  • Source-to-Target Analysis
  • Data Exposure Findings
  • Workshop Outputs
  • Assessment Documentation
  • Risk Inputs
  • Final Assessment Support Artifacts

Key Stakeholders

  • Business Teams
  • Data Architects
  • Security Architects
  • Data Engineers
  • Application Owners
