title: Forward Deployed Engineer, DACH
description:
About the Role

We're a fast-growing, Y Combinator-backed startup building an agentic operating system for enterprises — enabling large organizations to orchestrate AI agents that automate complex, mission-critical workflows. We're hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer based in Munich to embed directly with our largest DACH customers and help them become genuinely AI-native.

You'll work alongside our Enterprise AI Transformation Lead, acting as the on-the-ground technical expert: scoping, building, and shipping production-grade agents and integrations that deliver measurable value — and feeding those learnings back into the core product. This is a high-ownership, high-impact role at the intersection of elite engineering and customer partnership.

Significant travel across the DACH region is expected. You must be based in Munich or ready to relocate.

What You'll Do

  • Embed on-site with major DACH enterprise accounts, running workshops, hackathons, and implementation sprints.

  • Partner with customer CTOs and platform teams as a technical peer and strategic sparring partner.

  • Scope, build, integrate, debug, and teach teams to adopt production AI agents and multi-step workflows.

  • Ship end-to-end, high-leverage use cases: complex agents, custom integrations, MCP servers, and orchestrated workflows.

  • Leave behind systems customers can own and operate independently — no hand-holding required.

  • When platform limits appear, work directly with our engineering team and write fixes yourself.

  • Identify product blockers and implement customer-driven improvements that push the platform forward.

  • Automate your own work by building agents that eliminate manual, repetitive tasks.

What We're Looking For

Must-haves:

  • 3+ years of enterprise software engineering experience, with a track record of delivering production-grade AI agentic workflows for enterprise customers.

  • Hands-on experience shipping agentic AI systems, tool-use loops, and LLM-powered features that operate reliably under load.

  • Strong full-stack engineering skills — capable of scoping and implementing end-to-end solutions, including integrations with external systems and multi-step workflows.

  • Experience running on-site engagements with large enterprise customers (DACH preferred): workshops, hackathons, implementation sprints.

  • Ability to scope a complex use case in a customer meeting and deliver end-to-end — fast and pragmatically.

  • Experience building custom integrations with enterprise systems and MCP servers for agent deployment.

  • Native-level German proficiency — this is a dealbreaker requirement.

  • Based in Munich or genuinely willing to relocate; comfortable with frequent DACH travel.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Go programming language experience.

  • Founder or early-employee experience at a startup.

  • Experience with AI-assisted development tooling (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) for building agents.

Beyond the résumé, we value: high agency, high energy, low ego, sharp communication, and a strong ownership mindset. We prioritize slope and values alongside years of experience.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: $80,000 – $150,000 USD annually (or equivalent), depending on experience.

  • Equity participation in a well-funded, early-stage company.

  • Visa sponsorship: Not available — candidates must have the right to work in Germany.

Location

  • On-site, Munich, Bavaria, Germany.

  • Significant travel across the DACH region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland) is a core part of the role.

  • The company is headquartered in San Francisco with a growing DACH presence.

title: Medical Records Clerk
description:
SUMMARY

The Medical Records Clerk is responsible for maintaining and organizing patient medical records in a healthcare facility. Ensures accuracy, confidentiality, and accessibility of medical records, while adhering to legal and regulatory requirements. Assists healthcare professionals in retrieving and updating patient information as needed.

Chickasaw Nation Industries, Inc. serves as a holding company with multiple subsidiaries engaged in several lines of business (Business Services, Health, Infrastructure and Engineering, Mission Optimization, Technology and Transportation) for the federal government and commercial enterprises. A portion of our profits is used to support Chickasaw citizens. We are proud to support the economic development and long-term viability of the Chickasaw Nation and its people. CNI offers premium benefits eligible on the first day of hire to full time employees; (Medical - Dental – Vision), Company Life Insurance, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance, 401(K) Immediate Vesting, Professional Development Assistance, Legal Aid Assistance Program, Family Planning / Fertility Assistance, Personal Time Off, and Observance of Federal Holidays.

As a federal contractor, CNI is a drug-free workplace and adheres to the Federal Controlled Substance Act.

ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS

Must be able to obtain and maintain the required customer clearance for access to systems, facilities, equipment and property.

KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Maintains and updates patient medical records in an organized and efficient manner. Ensures the accuracy and completeness of medical records by verifying and entering patient information, such as demographics, medical history, and test results.
  • Reviews medical records for compliance with legal and regulatory requirements, including patient privacy and confidentiality. Retrieves and delivers medical records to healthcare professionals upon request, ensuring timely access to patient information.
  • Assists in the coding and indexing of medical records to facilitate accurate billing and insurance claims processing. Collaborates with healthcare professionals to ensure accurate and up-to-date documentation of patient care and treatment plans.
  • Responds to inquiries from healthcare professionals, patients, and authorized individuals regarding medical records and information. Maintains electronic and paper filing systems, ensuring proper organization and storage of medical records.
  • Follows established protocols for record retention, disposal, and archiving, in compliance with legal and regulatory guidelines.
  • Other duties may be assigned from time to time.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

High school diploma or general education degree (GED) and a minimum of one to three (1-3) years relevant experience and/or training, or equivalent combination of education/experience.

EOE including Disability/Vet

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Work is primarily performed in an office environment. Regularly required to sit. Regularly required use hands to finger, handle, or feel, reach with hands and arms to handle objects and operate tools, computer, and/or controls. Required to speak and hear. Occasionally required to stand, walk and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. Must frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. Exposed to general office noise with computers printers and light traffic.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this job.

Your application submission will be considered for all potential employment opportunities with Chickasaw Nation Industries (CNI).

title: Information Technology - (Sr.) Director, Food and Beverage Technology
description:
THE TEAM

The mission of the Food & Beverage Technology department is to design, build, deliver and operate scalable technology, data, analytics, and AI solutions that align with the strategic goals of Food & Beverage.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Aritzia is growing, and our Food & Beverage Technology team is growing with it. This is a unique opportunity to build a team from the ground up to support a high-growth area of Aritzia. You will advance the technology strategy that brings Everyday Luxury to life across Aritzia’s Food & Beverage environments, playing a pivotal role in designing and evolving the technology, data, analytics, and AI capabilities that power world-class experiences. You will own the end-to-end Food & Beverage technology domain, with the opportunity to imprint on the long-term strategy and tech stack for Food & Beverage at Aritzia, including the domain technology roadmap, platform selection, vendor negotiation, and solution development and configuration, ensuring our Food & Beverage technology ecosystem is robust, scalable, and future-ready. With people at the heart of everything we do, you will support your high-potential people to grow rewarding careers at Aritzia — while enjoying one yourself.

THE ROLE

As the (Sr) Director, Food & Beverage Technology, you will:

  • Own the complete Food & Beverage technology stack: POS, KDS, reservations, F&B ERP/inventory management, labor scheduling, payment processing, digital signage, and network infrastructure
  • Own end-to-end delivery of Food & Beverage technology implementation for our flagship boutiques
  • Lead RFP, vendor selection, and deployment including KDS, table management, online ordering, and payment certification
  • Govern the implementation partner relationship — holding the partner accountable to timeline, budget, and quality on a flagship-grade build
  • Stay current on technology innovations and bring relevant emerging capabilities to leadership for consideration, including owning and developing the technology roadmap in partnership with Food & Beverage business partners
  • Own the integration between Food & Beverage technology systems and Aritzia’s unified customer data layer, ensuring every guest interaction contributes to the client profile
  • Coordinate with loyalty program integration, ensuring Food & Beverage spend is recognized within the broader Aritzia client relationship
  • Make integration architecture decisions that affect both Food & Beverage and Retail technology domains
  • Build, scale, and lead the Food & Beverage technology team
  • Represent Food & Beverage Technology in cross-functional leadership forums and executive presentations
  • Manage all Food & Beverage technology risks, decisions, and escalations, with direct accountability
  • Partner with Finance on ongoing budget management and forecasting for the Food & Beverage technology portfolio
  • Work with the appropriate Business Support partners to seamlessly lead the day-to-day function of the department in support of corporate objectives, while enabling progressive career development and an incredible employee experience

THE QUALIFICATIONS

The (Sr) Director, Food & Beverage has:

  • Proven and best-in-class skills, education, experience and/or applicable certifications:
  • 10+ years of technology leadership experience, with significant exposure to food and beverage, hospitality, or restaurant technology environments
  • Deep knowledge of F&B technology ecosystems — POS platforms (Oracle MICROS Simphony strongly preferred), KDS, reservations systems, inventory management, and labor scheduling
  • Proven experience delivering complex, multi-vendor technology implementations in elevated dining or premium hospitality environments
  • Strong commercial acumen — experience negotiating enterprise software agreements and managing implementation partner relationships to fixed-fee deliverables
  • Track record of building new technology capabilities or teams from the ground up, not just inheriting established ones
  • Experience integrating hospitality technology systems with enterprise customer data platforms or loyalty programs
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills — comfortable operating at the executive level and with front-line operations teams simultaneously
  • Global experience, especially within North America
  • Experience at a premium retail, luxury hospitality, or lifestyle brand is strongly preferred
  • A commitment to learn, apply, champion, and enrich Aritzia's Values, Business and People Leadership principles
  • The skills to collaborate strategically with cross-functional partners in the pursuit of shared business outcomes
  • The ability to set clear objectives and design a strategy that inspires the team
  • A dedication to quality and investing in results and new business opportunities that add value
  • A deep understanding and commitment for the industry in which we operate

THE PERKS

Some of the industry-leading benefits you will receive working at Aritzia:

  • Product Discount — Maybe you’ve heard of our famous product discount? Or our exclusive private shopping events? You have now.

title: Dosimetrist II - III
description:
About Us:

The people of Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSK) are united by a singular mission: ending cancer for life. Our specialized care teams provide personalized, compassionate, expert care to patients of all ages. Informed by basic research done at our Sloan Kettering Institute, scientists across MSK collaborate to conduct innovative translational and clinical research that is driving a revolution in our understanding of cancer as a disease and improving the ability to prevent, diagnose, and treat it. MSK is dedicated to training the next generation of scientists and clinicians, who go on to pursue our mission at MSK and around the globe.

Exciting Opportunity at MSK: Join our Department of Medical Physics as experienced Medical Dosimetrist II/III. Eligible experienced dosimetrists (e.g., two or more years full-time equivalent as a Dosimetrist) may be able to work in a hybrid arrangement with an estimated 10 onsite days per year based on clinical needs.

Role Overview:

As a key team member, you will provide treatment planning support for patients undergoing external beam radiotherapy, working closely with radiation oncologists, physicists, and therapists. This position will be part of the MSK Basking Ridge (Basking Ridge, New Jersey) team, and the primary role will be a focus on Head and Neck, Spine SBRT, Mets SBRT, Brain and Brain SRS/SBRT external beam treatment planning for all MSK campuses.

Key Qualifications:

  • Certification by the Medical Dosimetry Certification Board (MDCB).
  • A strong understanding of physics principles, radiation therapy, and treatment planning processes.
  • Proficiency in performing mathematical calculations and the ability to resolve radiotherapy-related issues.
  • Knowledge of radiation dosimetry calibration and radiation physics.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Core Skills:

  • Expertise in treatment planning, dose calculation, and radiation therapy simulation.
  • Ability to obtain, interpret, and apply patient-specific information to develop accurate treatment plans.
  • Experience with Head and Neck, Spine/Mets SBRT, Brain and Brain SRS/SBRT treatment planning, including image registration, is expected. Experience with previous treatment evaluation preferred.
  • Consult and collaborate effectively with radiation oncologists, therapists, and medical physicists.
  • Participate in quality assurance procedures, reviewing dose calculations, documentation, and patient records.
  • Educate and mentor junior staff, fellows, and others on treatment planning systems and departmental policies.
  • Present at departmental meetings, in-service training sessions, and professional workshops.
  • Stay current with new procedures, techniques, and technologies in the field of medical dosimetry.
  • Treat all patients and colleagues with the utmost respect, ensuring their unique needs are met.

Additional Information:

  • Work hours: Flexible hours between 7:00 AM to 11:00 PM, Monday through Friday.
  • Location: One or several of the MSK campuses depending on clinical needs in a hybrid work mode with an estimated 10 onsite days per year based on clinical needs.
  • Opportunities for professional growth through workshops, conferences, and hands-on testing of new technologies.
  • Report to Lead Dosimetrist or Chief Physicist, depending on work location.
  • Pay Range – $124,000 - $227,000 depending on experience level.

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. The Manufacturing Controls & Automation Engineer plays a critical role in maintaining, upgrading, and optimizing our manufacturing processes. The successful candidate will design robust automation solutions, troubleshoot complex electrical and control systems, and collaborate with teams to drive continuous improvement and operational reliability throughout our facility. title: Neuroscience PhD (Computational / Active Inference)

About the Role

This is a founding technical role at a Y Combinator–backed consumer healthtech startup building a wearable that quantifies emotional states in real time. The company is early-stage (team of ~5), already has prototypes on users' wrists, and is growing fast. You'll own the core inference model that powers the product — bridging cutting-edge computational neuroscience with production machine learning engineering.

This is not a pure research role. Computational neuroscientists here effectively double as ML engineers, taking models from research through to deployment.

  • Grow into a leadership role as the company scales

Required

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying inference models to quantify emotional or physiological states from wearable sensor data

  • Strong machine learning engineering skills: model development, evaluation, and deployment

  • Experience with active inference frameworks and computational neuroscience methods

  • Comfort working on-site (San Francisco or London) and ability to work without new visa sponsorship (visa transfers considered for the London office)

Nice to Have

  • Experience working in a fast-moving, early-stage environment

Not a fit: Candidates with a wet-lab-only neuroscience background and no computational or ML engineering experience.

title: Senior Algorithm Engineer
description:
This position defines and validates the core measurement algorithms for a handheld laser 3D scanner.

This role is responsible for building the CPU reference algorithms, calibration logic, subpixel accuracy model, and 3D reconstruction pipeline that guide FPGA implementation and determine final measurement quality.

1. Develop CPU reference algorithms for:
• laser stripe extraction
• subpixel center localization
• noise filtering
• feature validation
• triangulation-based 3D reconstruction
2. Define the algorithm reference flow for:
Image → Stripe → Subpixel → 3D Point → Point Cloud
3. Build golden datasets and validation methods for FPGA comparison.
4. Define accuracy metrics and error evaluation methods, including:
• pixel-level error
• subpixel deviation
• point cloud consistency
• calibration residuals
• repeatability
5. Work with the FPGA engineer to translate algorithm logic into hardware-friendly modules.
6. Work with the system engineer to define data formats, interfaces, and validation checkpoints.
7. Support calibration, prototype testing, and measurement performance analysis.

1. Strong background in image processing, computer vision, or 3D measurement algorithms
2. Proficiency in C++ / Python / MATLAB for algorithm development and validation
3. Experience with at least one of the following:
• laser stripe extraction
• subpixel localization
• camera calibration
• triangulation
• point cloud processing
4. Ability to build reference algorithms and compare outputs across software and hardware implementations
5. Strong analytical ability in accuracy, repeatability, and error source analysis

title: Physician
description:
Wound Care Physician – No Call, Zero Overhead

Are you tired of hospital politics, crushing administrative overhead, and shrinking clinical autonomy? Being a physician in Alabama right now comes with unique pressures. Between navigating vague legal landscapes, battling insurance companies, and working with short-staffed teams, it’s easy to feel disconnected from why you entered medicine in the first place.

At Skilled Wound Care, we offer a different path. We are a leading national wound care physician group seeking motivated MDs and DOs who want to step off the hospital treadmill, leave the legal and administrative burnout behind, and get back to practicing pure medicine.

As a mobile wound care physician and independent contractor, you will provide critical, hands-on care to a vulnerable geriatric population in nursing facilities. You make the clinical decisions. You manage your outcomes. We handle the rest.

Why Transition to Skilled Wound Care?

  • True Autonomy as an Independent Contractor: As a 1099 provider, you are truly your own boss. Enjoy the ultimate freedom, flexibility, and tax advantages of independent practice without the crippling overhead of running a traditional brick-and-mortar clinic.
  • Practice Pure Medicine, Free from Politics: Leave the legal ambiguity and hospital micromanagement behind. Your only focus is healing the patient in front of you, utilizing the latest advancements in wound healing.
  • Zero Overhead & Uncapped Earning Potential: Escape the financial strain of private practice. We handle the facility contracts and billing. Full-time physicians earn an average starting pay of $220,000 - $250,000 annually, with the potential to earn up to $300,000+ through additional services, performance-based bonuses, and no earning cap.
  • Reclaim Your Time (No Call, No Weekends): Stop sacrificing your personal life. There are no nights, no on-call emergencies, and no weekend rounds.
  • Say Goodbye to Data-Entry Burnout: We utilize a custom software system specifically designed to drastically reduce physician administrative and documentation time, so you can spend your time treating patients, not screens.

Compensation & Comprehensive Support

We invest heavily in our physicians so you feel confident and supported from day one:

  • Pay Structure: Per-patient visit pay, per-procedure pay.
  • Bonus Program: Quarterly bonus program with the potential to earn up to 30% extra income.
  • Company-Provided Training: Comprehensive wound care training provided, including biannual CME conferences.

Requirements

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) from an accredited institution.
  • Active, clear, and unrestricted Texas medical license.
  • Active and unrestricted DEA license.
  • Note: You do not need to have completed a full residency program and do not need to be Board Certified/Eligible to thrive in this role.

A Supportive, Dynamic Environment

Wound care is a rapidly advancing field, and the current energy among our providers is electric. But don't just take our word for it:

"I love the camaraderie and support I receive from my colleagues at Skilled Wound Care. The last team retreat weekend in Miami was a great way to connect and learn from each other, developing greater enjoyment through our evening events." > – Dr. Tim O., former surgery resident and current SWC Physician.

If you are a compassionate, skilled physician ready to make a lasting impact on your community while reclaiming your career and personal life, we encourage you to apply.

title: Staff Software Development Engineer – Agentic Applications and Experiences
description:
The WEX Fleet Services team which owns the Over the Road experiences is transforming the future of fleet payments by building agentic, scalable solutions that power WEX’s industry-leading fuel card platform. We design and develop new capabilities that enable delightful experiences for both internal and external customers, creating the foundation for new products, services, and business opportunities.

We are looking for a passionate Senior Software Development Engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, passionate about learning and experimenting, building innovative solutions, and collaborating with a talented engineering team. In this role, you will play a key part in designing, developing, and enhancing agentic solutions in a cloud-native environment using industry-leading AI tools/platforms, Java, AWS, Kafka event streaming, Elasticsearch, containerization, and API-driven architectures.

This is an opportunity to join an agile, collaborative team where engineers have ownership, make meaningful technical contributions, and deliver solutions that directly impact WEX’s customers and business growth.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Design, develop, and deliver delightful product experiences that are powered by Agentic capabilities, scalable, reliable software solutions using modern technologies such as Java, Kafka, Elasticsearch, and cloud-native platforms.

  • Contribute to architecture and design decisions that support highly available, secure, and scalable systems.

  • Build and maintain clean, efficient, well-tested, and maintainable code.

  • Develop and optimize RESTful APIs and backend services.

  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and collaborative problem-solving sessions.

  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex technical challenges.

  • Work across technology stacks and quickly adapt to new tools and frameworks.

  • Stay current with emerging technologies and industry best practices to continuously improve engineering practices.

  • Ensure operational excellence and best customer experience for all the products and systems owned by the team.

Experience You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience designing, developing, and supporting enterprise-scale applications.

  • Strong experience building cloud-based applications and infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code practices.

  • Proficiency with event streaming platforms such as Kafka.

  • Experience with Elasticsearch, including indexing strategies, query optimization, and data analysis.

  • Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS.

  • Strong understanding of software engineering principles, including data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, scalability, availability, and reliability.

  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze complex technical challenges.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative mindset.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience.

  • Experience and knowledge in building Agentic/AI solutions for real world problems.

  • Experience designing and implementing event-driven architectures.

  • Experience working with card payments or financial services platforms.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud-native technologies including Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Knowledge of API security principles and PCI DSS compliance requirements.

  • Experience working within existing codebases and improving legacy systems.

  • Strong backend development expertise with Java or C#, including frameworks such as Spring Boot.

  • Experience designing, building, and optimizing RESTful APIs, OData services, and SQL-based solutions.

  • Proven experience developing internet-scale services with a focus on scalability, security, availability, and reliability.

title: Pest Technician Trainee
description:

We are proud to be a member of the Rentokil family of companies, the global leader in Pest Control and other services across more than 90 countries. We pride ourselves on being a trusted partner to many of the world's leading brands and serve consumer and business customers across multiple industries. We are extremely proud of our legacy of excellence and constantly work to fulfill our mission to "protect people, enhance lives, and preserve the planet."

What do our Pest Control Technicians do?

The primary purpose of this role is to perform our industry leading pest management services for residential customers. You will be responsible for identifying and eliminating pests from residential properties by conducting thorough inspections, determining the type of pest infestation, applying appropriate treatments like pesticides and traps, and providing preventative measures to prevent future infestations, all while adhering to safety regulations and communicating with clients about pest control solutions.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:

  • Conduct thorough inspections of client properties to identify signs of pest infestations, damage, and entry points

  • Apply approved pest control products, including chemicals, baits, and traps, to effectively eliminate pests while adhering to safety standards

  • Educate customers on pest prevention methods and the importance of maintaining a pest-free environment. Provide advice on how to reduce the risk of future infestations.

  • Build relationships with customers, schedule and confirm their appointments, help with sales to current customers, and expand our product to new customers

  • Ensure that all pest control equipment is properly maintained, stocked, and in good working condition

  • Adhere to all local, state, and federal regulations regarding pest control products and safety protocols

  • Drive and safely operate a company provided service vehicle (we provide routine maintenance)

Essential Job Functions:

  • Working in tight, confined spaces such as basements, attics, crawl spaces, narrow aisles, or passageways

  • Working around animals, insects and termites

  • You’ll sometimes be working around mechanical parts, vehicles, electrical current, heights and scaffolding, fumes, dust, and chemicals, and we’ll train you how to handle all of these conditions safely

  • Able to work both inside and outside in your local climate in company-provided weather gear

  • Lots of moving around — regularly sitting, climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, and crawling, up and down stairs, ladders, scaffolding, ramps, and poles

  • You’ll need to wear personal protective equipment (PPE), like an OSHA-compliant respirator

What do you need?

  • Clean shaven face- for safety reasons (rebreathers have to be able to seal your face)

  • High school diploma or GED; related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience

  • Successfully meet pre-employment background screen

  • Possess a state valid driver’s license and undergo motor vehicle driving record check (Company vehicle and gas card provided)

  • Licenses/certificates as required by federal, state, and/or local regulations (covered by us)

  • Available to work Monday-Friday and weekends as needed

  • Open to learning and becoming knowledgeable in all areas of pest control

  • Solid reading, writing, and verbal communication skills

  • Basic math skills — You’ll need to be able to follow instructions for mixing on product labels

  • Customer-facing experience preferred

Why Choose Us?

A career with the Rentokil family of companies can be a professional trajectory filled with opportunity. We pride ourselves on being a world-class team that rewards high performance, and we love to promote from within. We offer competitive pay and many of our roles offer performance incentives.

· Monitor key operational metrics (staffing vacancies, ADP, capacity utilization, incident rates) and drive process improvement.

· Oversee launch and management of onsite units at prison facilities frequently in person to ensure readiness and integration with MUSC Health.

· Available to clients, staff and ICCE Leadership over the phone and by email during all operational hours.

· Serve as the primary operational liaison between MUSC Corrections Health ICCE, external partners (county jails, prison leadership, and other regional entities) & MUSC Divisional leadership.

· Develop and maintain strong partnerships to anticipate client needs, resolve operational challenges, and improve service delivery.

· Participate in strategic and operational committees to align corrections healthcare goals with MUSC’s mission.

· Participate in frequent in-person and virtual meetings with clients and MUSC leaders across the state.

Financial, Contract, and Performance Management

· Develop, manage, and monitor budgets, proformas, and resource allocations for correctional health contracts.

· Track expenditures, staffing costs, vendor performance, and contract revenue alignment.

· Prepare reports for leadership detailing contract performance, financial results, and operational effectiveness.

Process Improvement & Quality Outcomes

· Identify and resolve operational inefficiencies in correctional health service delivery.

· Ensure compliance with NCCHC standards, security protocols, and regulatory requirements.

· Foster a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, and high performance.

Team Leadership & Development

· Lead operations managers and project teams overseeing correctional health contracts.

· Support professional growth, performance management, and collaboration within the team.

· Demonstrate negotiation and facilitation skills to work effectively with executive leadership and external partners.

· Demonstrated success in contract development, RFP management, and healthcare business growth.

· Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities; adept at engaging with executives and correctional leaders.

· Knowledge of correctional healthcare systems highly preferred.

· Ability to work in a dynamic environment with frequent travel throughout the state.

About Us

We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best-in-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead.

Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today!

If you are a Product Management professional, especially with an engineering background, and looking for an opportunity to grow, Copeland has an exciting opportunity for you!

Based at our Sidney, OH location, the Product Manager, Power Electronics owns the entire product lifecycle, from conceptualization to obsolescence, defining what to build by translating market and customer needs into solutions that deliver profitable growth and competitive differentiation. This role is responsible for developing product roadmaps, managing product P&L, and ensuring alignment with customer needs and market opportunities. The Product Manager partners cross-functionally to deliver and maintain innovative, high-impact products that meet business objectives.

As a Product Manager, Power Electronics, you will:

  • Develop and execute 5-year product roadmaps, managing the product lifecycle from development to obsolescence

  • Set product priorities for new developments and manage product P&L to optimize margins

  • Create comprehensive business cases outlining expected returns

  • Define product positioning and ensure designs meet customer use cases

  • Own and accurately maintain product information throughout the lifecycle

  • Gather and analyze Voice of Customer insights to inform product features and functionality

  • Translate market and customer insights into clear product requirements, features, and technical direction

  • Balance growth, cost, and profitability through disciplined product portfolio and lifecycle management

  • Own product data integrity and structure, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and alignment with global data standards to enable effective commercialization, analytics, and digital tools•Support pricing strategy and execution by providing product inputs (e.g., cost, features, value drivers) and partnering with Pricing to enable value-based pricing, margin optimization, and competitive positioning

  • Develop and support sales enablement tools (e.g., product documentation, technical collateral, value drivers) to ensure accurate representation of product capabilities and effective customer engagement

  • Partner cross-functionally (engineering, operations, commercial) to ensure successful delivery and adoption

  • Continuously refine products based on performance, feedback, and evolving customer needs

KPIs:

  • Revenue and profitability by product line

  • Market share growth vs. competitors

  • ROI on new product development

  • Roadmap execution (on-time, in-scope delivery)

  • Customer satisfaction and product adoption

SCHEDULE:​

This role is hybrid eligible with the requirement to be in office at least three days per week. Colleagues are expected to demonstrate a collaboration first mindset, which is the understanding that teams will work together in-person and colleagues should be flexible to adjust their hybrid days based on business needs. You will have an opportunity to work with your team and leader to determine when you should be in office to drive meaningful connections and to best serve our customers.

REQUIRED EDUCATION, EXPERIENCES & SKILLS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, marketing or related field

  • 3-5 years of experience in product management, product marketing, engineering, strategy or a related role

  • Demonstrated industry experience managing products through multiple stages of the product lifecycle, including development, launch, growth, maturity and obsolescence

  • Experience analyzing product financial performance, including revenue, cost, margin, profitability and return on investment

  • Experience supporting new product development and commercialization activities

  • Strong project-management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and drive execution

  • Ability to understand technical products and communicate effectively with both technical and nontechnical stakeholders

PREFERRED EDUCATION, EXPERIENCES & SKILLS:

  • Experience in power electronics, variable-frequency drives, inverter drives, motor controls or related electronic control systems is highly preferred

  • Master’s degree in business administration, engineering, marketing or a related field

  • Working knowledge of the markets, products, customers, and competitors in the HVAC industry

title: Meat Cutter
description:
As a member of the C&S Wholesale Grocers family of companies, SpartanNash is a food solutions company that delivers the ingredients for a better life. A distributor, wholesaler and retailer with a global supply chain network, SpartanNash distributes grocery and household goods, including fresh produce and the Our Family® portfolio of products, to locations in all 50 states.

Our braggingly happy team members — ranging from bakery managers to order selectors; from IT developers to vice presidents of finance; from HR Business Partners to export specialists — create braggingly happy customers spanning national accounts, independent and chain grocers, e-commerce retailers, U.S. military commissaries and exchanges, and the Company’s own brick-and-mortar grocery stores, pharmacies and fuel centers.

Ready to contribute to the success of our food solutions company? Apply now!

Location:

7355 Heritage Square Drive - Granger, Indiana 46530

Position Summary:
This role is responsible to properly cut all types of meats into various types of cuts and all preparation of related products in the variety, size, quality, and trim prescribed by company and department standards; to ensure that the work shift contributes to the financial best interests of the store. Complete all other duties as assigned in a timely manner.

Here’s what you’ll do:

  • Cut and weigh steaks, chops, etc. for individual servings.

  • Produce 'value-added' products per established guidelines.

  • Cut, trim, and bone carcass sections or prime cuts to reduce to cooking cuts. ​​

  • Follow established recipes to grind and tray meats and make sausage and other products.

  • Price, date, wrap and/or bag meat products per established guidelines using department scales.

  • Properly fill, rotate and merchandise shelves, cases and displays.

  • Notify the manager if products and supplies need to be ordered.

  • Receives, unloads, and stocks merchandise.

  • Have familiarity with all products carried in the department; know differences in price, taste, preparation, use etc.

  • Practice suggestive selling techniques with customers.

  • Maintain a clean, attractive and well stocked department.

  • Follow all PPE and Safety Guidelines

  • Follow all Food Safety and Cleaning Expectations

  • Follow guest experience guidelines

  • May be assigned tasks in other departments based on customer experience need

  • Additional responsibilities may be assigned as needed

Here’s what you’ll need:

  • High school diploma or GED

  • One (1) year retail or other related experience preferred.
    Prior experience in a Meat Cutter, Apprentice role strongly preferred.

  • Ability to read, write, comprehend, and interpret documents

  • Basic mathematical skills

  • Suggestive Selling/Knowledge of Products

  • Detail Oriented

Physical Requirements:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. May be required to lift and/or move up to 30 pounds frequently, and up to 50 pounds occasionally. The associate is required to stand and walk for extended periods of time and may bend, stoop, twist and turn frequently. While performing the duties of this position, the employee is subject to a typical retail store environment (varied temperatures) and is exposed to outside weather conditions. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate. Travel requirements vary by assignment.

As part of our People First culture, SpartanNash is proud to offer a robust and competitive Total Rewards benefits package.

SpartanNash is an Equal Opportunity Employer that invests in Associate development, recognizes and celebrates success, fosters two-way communication, and promotes a sense of belonging. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals, including those with disabilities and Veterans.

We are not able to sponsor work visas for this position.

title: Implementation Project Consultant
location: Chicago, IL United States of America
description:
C.H. Robinson is seeking an Implementation Project Consultant to join our Robinson Managed Solutions (RMS) Implementation team. You will be responsible for managing the technical integration and system setup for Implementation projects from conception to Go Live & support (sales to operations). You will focus primarily on the onboarding of new business, will also support projects for current customers as needed, and will provide support to others in their area of expertise. Daily tasks will focus on the documentation of customer requirements, regularly coordinate with the Project Manager, collaborate with Technology resources to electronically integrate customer systems, configure systems, and aid in the communication of project progress.

This position may be based in either our Chicago Central or Monterrey, MX locations.

**The deadline to apply for this position is Thursday, July 2nd at 4:00pm CST**

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

The duties and responsibilities of this position consists of, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Serve as the technical liaison between customer project teams (including their Technology function) and internal Development resources.

  • Translate customer requirements into internal system and operational specifications; identify system gaps and recommend enhancements.

  • Facilitate project meetings and execute the Process Transformation Methodology, including current state capture, future state design, and integration mapping.

  • Document customer expectations, implementation survey results, and changes in roles and responsibilities.

  • Develop and execute testing plans, SOPs, and training materials; conduct training on internal systems and external portals.

  • Coordinate with the Project Manager to manage meeting documentation and ensure timely execution of project deliverables.

  • Oversee project team progress, including cross-functional support groups, and contribute to tool and methodology development.

  • Support the customer account team during go-live and ensure smooth knowledge transfer throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Assist with managing helpdesk (myQ) ticket queues for Customer Integration and Implementation teams.

  • Ensure compliance with SOC processes and perform other duties as assigned based on team or country-specific needs.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college/university or equivalent C.H. Robinson experience

  • A minimum of 2 years of technical project management experience

  • Prior experience working with customers, vendors, or carriers

  • Previous experience with TMS software

  • Flexible hours (some weekend/late hours may be required)

  • Up to 20% travel may be required (domestic and/or international)

Preferred:

  • Basic facilitation skills including but not limited to relationship management, presentation, discussion, documentation, and accountability

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite of programs

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Demonstrated ability to design, develop and deliver presentations for internal and external audiences at all levels

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with subject matter experts internally and externally at all levels

  • Understands key business drivers; uses this understanding to accomplish own work

  • Solves problems and analyzes possible solutions using technical experience and judgment and precedents

  • Explains complex information to others in straightforward situations

  • Values a diverse and inclusive work environment

We will review applications for this role on an ongoing basis and encourage all interested candidates to apply at their earliest convenience.

Compensation Range

$81,000.00 - $128,000.00

The base pay range displayed on the job posting reflects the minimum and maximum base pay for this specific location. Your individual base pay within this range is determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base pay only and do not include additional variable compensation.

Questioning if you meet the mark? Studies have shown that some individuals may be less likely to apply unless they match the job description exactly. Here at C.H. Robinson, we’re building an inclusive workplace where all employees feel they belong. If this position excites you, we welcome you to apply whether you check all the preferred qualifications or just a few. You may just be our next great fit!

Equal Opportunity

C.H. Robinson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to a workplace and performance culture that reflects the strengths of our worldwide marketplace. We value unique experiences and diverse backgrounds of our people within our company, our business relationships, and our communities. We’re committed to providing an inclusive environment, free from harassment and discrimination, where all employees feel welcomed, valued and respected.

EOE\Disabled\Veteran

Benefits

Your Health, Wealth and Self

Your total wellbeing is the foundation of our business, and our benefits support your financial, family and personal goals. We provide the top-tier benefits that matter to you most, including:

  • Three medical plans which include

    • Prescription drug coverage

    • Enhanced Fertility benefits

  • Flexible Spending Accounts

  • Health Savings Account (including employer contribution)

  • Paid parental leave

description:

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. A valid driver's license is essential for this role.

CAREERS THAT CHANGE LIVES - POSITION DESCRIPTION:

CRM seeks collaborative candidates who will meet our customer expectations by striving without reserve for the greatest possible reliability and quality in our products, processes, and systems by being accountable, having a voice and taking action.

CS’s are required to work a number of weekends and holidays during the quarter, as determined by local management. Weeknight call coverage is the primary responsibility of the Sales Rep, however, at times, business and/or geographical needs require a CS to be scheduled for weeknight coverage as approved by regional management.

title: Oliver Wyman – Platform / Infrastructure Engineer (m/f/d) – Quotient AI Specialist – London
description:
Company:

Oliver Wyman

Description:

Who we are

Oliver Wyman is a global management consulting firm. We work with clients through their most defining moments, combining deep industry knowledge, specialized expertise, and the power of perspective to help them adapt, grow, and thrive.

We believe diverse perspectives make the work stronger. Our consultants bring different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of thinking to help solve complex problems and create lasting impact for clients, colleagues, and communities.

At Oliver Wyman, we are proud of the values that we aspire to live by. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

Quotient — AI by Oliver Wyman brings together deep industry insight, strategic advisory, and hands-on AI delivery to help organizations move from proof to production and from production to enterprise value.

The role

WAVE is a newly created team within Quotient. It exists to accelerate AI-enabled business development and help our teams move faster, think differently, and build with reuse in mind.

As Platform / Infrastructure Engineer, you will own the foundations that make WAVE work. You will design and maintain the infrastructure that allows a small, fast-moving team to prototype quickly, deploy reliably, and scale with confidence. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys building dependable engineering foundations and creating self-serve platforms that help others move faster.

What you will do

You will create the infrastructure that lets WAVE move from idea to deployment with speed, consistency, and control.

You will:

  • Design, build, and maintain the team’s cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines.

  • Set up CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and disaster-recovery capabilities so solutions can move from prototype to deployment quickly and repeatably.

  • Provide infrastructure as a service to the rest of the team through self-serve environments that do not bottleneck on you.

  • Advise on the right infrastructure setup for each solution, including what is needed to support scale.

  • Work closely with the AI Engineers to ensure their work can be deployed, monitored, and maintained effectively.

  • Help WAVE make practical choices about environment design, release management, and operational resilience.

  • Support a consistent engineering experience across projects, so the team can build once and reuse where possible.

  • Contribute to a platform mindset across WAVE, where infrastructure is treated as a product the team can rely on.

How you will be measured

Our success is simple to state: the team should be able to move fast without losing reliability. You’ll know you are succeeding when engineers can self-serve the environments they need, when deployments are smooth and repeatable, and when the infrastructure consistently supports a growing pipeline of reusable AI work.

Why join us?

You can be your best here. At Oliver Wyman, you will find meaningful work, talented people, and a culture built on trust, support, and growth.

Create solutions that have impact

  • Build the technical foundations that help WAVE deliver AI-enabled work faster and more reliably.

  • Help turn promising ideas into deployable solutions that can support proposals, prototypes, and reusable assets.

  • Be part of a team where your work directly shapes what the business can build, reuse, and scale.

Develop as a leader

  • Take ownership from day one in a role that sits at the centre of WAVE’s engineering environment.

  • Build credibility by helping others move quickly without compromising quality, reliability, or good engineering practice.

  • Lead through technical judgement, practical problem solving, and clear communication.

Learn without limits

  • Build a rare mix of cloud engineering, platform thinking, and exposure to AI-enabled consulting work.

  • Work closely with AI Engineers, the Technical Business Partner, and colleagues across Quotient and the wider firm.

  • Deepen your understanding of how to design infrastructure for speed, reuse, and scale in a consulting environment.

Thrive in a vibrant and inclusive culture

  • Work as part of a collaborative team that values different perspectives and practical problem solving.

  • Help shape how a new team grows, in a culture where people are encouraged to speak up, share ideas, and move quickly together.

  • Join an environment that supports inclusion, teamwork, and mutual respect.

Experience rewards that work for you

  • Enjoy a role designed for learning, visibility, and growth inside a newly created team.

  • Be part of a pilot that is built to scale, giving you exposure to how a new capability is shaped from the ground up.

  • Work in a way that supports performance, development, and sustainability.

Who can apply?

We are looking for someone who is comfortable building and running internal platforms that other engineers depend on. The right person will combine strong engineering depth with practical judgement, and will enjoy working in a small team where infrastructure directly shapes delivery speed and quality.

This role is well suited to someone who wants to work at the intersection of cloud engineering, platform reliability, and AI-enabled delivery.

Required qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes and a major cloud platform, ideally Azure and/or AWS.

  • Solid experience with CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code.

  • Experience designing and supporting disaster-recovery capabilities.

  • Ability to build and run internal platforms that other engineers depend on.

  • Practical understanding of how to support deployment, reliability, and scale across multiple solutions.

  • Full professional English.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience supporting data and AI workloads in production.

  • Familiarity with Polaris

  • Experience working in a fast-moving environment with multiple concurrent initiatives.

  • Experience shaping platform standards or reusable engineering patterns.

How to apply

Please submit your CV and cover letter. If shortlisted, you will be invited to meet members of the WAVE team and discuss your experience, motivation, and approach to the role.

What to expect during the interview process

At Oliver Wyman, we want you to shine in your interview. Our process is designed like our work environment — it is challenging, exciting, and fun.

We keep our process short and transparent:

  • Screening conversation with the team lead.
  • Technical exercise relevant to the role, either take-home or live depending on the stage.
  • Two to three team-fit and craft interviews, including at least one with a partner.
  • Offer.

We assess both technical craft and the ability to work fluidly with a multidisciplinary team.

Oliver Wyman is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit oliverwyman.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age background, civil partnership status, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, gender reassignment, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to providing reasonable adjustments in accordance with applicable law to any candidate with a disability to allow them to fully participate in the recruitment process. If you have a disability that may require reasonable adjustments, please contact us at reasonableaccommodations@marsh.com.

Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

This leader will define and execute the long-term vision for social commerce in the UK, transforming it into a scalable growth engine that accelerates revenue, strengthens brand engagement, and delivers sustainable profitability.

In addition to leading the TikTok Shop business, this role will own SharkNinja's UK TikTok LIVE Commerce strategy and operations, building a world-class live shopping capability that drives customer acquisition, engagement, conversion, and revenue through always-on live programming, creator partnerships, and scalable live production. This leader will also partner closely with international markets to develop scalable playbooks and best practices that can be adapted to support global social commerce expansion.

As the commercial leader for Social Commerce (UK), you will build the strategy, operating model, and organizational capabilities required to support significant growth across creator-led, live shopping, and shoppable ecosystems. You will oversee the evolution of our social commerce business from a high-growth channel into a mature, scalable capability by developing repeatable processes, investing in technology and analytics, and building high-performing teams that can execute at speed.

This role requires an entrepreneurial leader who thrives in ambiguity, can build from first principles, and has a proven track record of scaling ecommerce businesses in fast-paced consumer environments. You will partner closely with executive leaders across Marketing, Digital Commerce, Sales, Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Product, and International Markets to ensure the UK social commerce business is positioned for long-term success while helping establish global best practices.

Success in this role will be measured not only by revenue growth and profitability, but by building the infrastructure, capabilities, partnerships, and talent required to support the next phase of SharkNinja's ecommerce growth.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the end-to-end P&L for SharkNinja's UK Social Commerce business, establishing ambitious revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, and market share objectives while delivering against aggressive growth targets.
  • Develop and execute the long-term UK Social Commerce strategy across TikTok Shop, TikTok LIVE, Instagram, YouTube, and emerging commerce platforms, ensuring alignment with broader ecommerce, digital, and brand strategies.
  • Build and scale a best-in-class social commerce organization, designing the team structure, operating model, processes, and capabilities required to support rapid growth and establish repeatable frameworks for future international expansion.
  • Establish scalable operating rhythms, governance, and performance management frameworks that enable efficient execution across creator partnerships, affiliate marketing, live commerce operations, merchandising, content production, campaign execution, and platform operations.
  • Lead SharkNinja's UK TikTok LIVE Commerce business, developing the end-to-end strategy for live shopping including programming, creator and host recruitment, production, merchandising, promotional planning, live selling operations, and performance optimization to establish LIVE as a significant revenue, customer acquisition, and brand engagement channel.
  • Lead the evolution of creator, affiliate, and LIVE host ecosystems, developing sophisticated partner segmentation, recruitment strategies, commission structures, incentive models, and performance frameworks that maximize long-term commercial value across both shoppable content and live commerce.
  • Identify and unlock new growth opportunities through customer acquisition, conversion optimization, assortment strategy, merchandising, promotional planning, live event programming, and lifecycle engagement.
  • Partner closely with Marketing, Brand, Media, CRM, Product Marketing, Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, Operations, Creative, and Technology to create seamless, integrated customer journeys that connect social discovery with purchase, including coordinated product launches, tentpole campaigns, and TikTok LIVE selling events.
  • Build robust forecasting, financial planning, and investment models that balance rapid growth with sustainable profitability while providing executive leadership with clear visibility into performance, risks, and opportunities.
  • Develop scalable reporting, analytics, and KPI frameworks that leverage platform data, first-party customer insights, and business intelligence to continuously optimize commercial performance across social commerce and live shopping initiatives.
  • Evaluate and implement technologies, automation, and operational improvements that improve efficiency, reduce manual execution, and enable the organization to scale effectively.
  • Partner with international markets to establish repeatable playbooks, operating models, and best practices that accelerate social commerce and live commerce adoption globally while adapting to local platform dynamics and consumer behaviours.
  • Monitor competitive activity, platform innovation, creator economy trends, live shopping best practices, and emerging technologies to identify new business opportunities and maintain SharkNinja's leadership position within social commerce.
  • Serve as the executive voice of Social Commerce, influencing enterprise ecommerce strategy and representing the function with senior leadership, platform partners, agencies, creators, and key external stakeholders.
  • Recruit, develop, and retain exceptional talent while fostering a high-performance culture focused on innovation, accountability, agility, and continuous improvement.
  • Champion SharkNinja's values and culture, inspiring teams to deliver breakthrough thinking, exceptional execution, and industry-leading results.

About You

  • Experience in progressive leadership experience across ecommerce, digital commerce, marketplace, social commerce, performance marketing, or omnichannel retail, with experience scaling high-growth consumer businesses.
  • Demonstrated success owning a multimillion pound P&L with responsibility for revenue growth, profitability, forecasting, investment planning, and executive reporting.
  • Proven track record building and scaling ecommerce organizations through periods of rapid growth, including designing teams, operating models, and scalable business processes.
  • Experience building and scaling TikTok LIVE Commerce or other livestream shopping businesses, including live programming strategy, creator or host management, production workflows, merchandising, and performance optimization.
  • Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives across Marketing, Commercial, Operations, Technology, Finance, Supply Chain, Creative, and Product teams.
  • Deep understanding of social commerce platforms, creator ecosystems, affiliate marketing, livestream commerce, content-driven commerce, and evolving consumer purchasing behaviours.
  • Strong analytical and commercial mindset with experience leveraging data, experimentation, and customer insights to drive strategic decisions.
  • Experience implementing scalable systems, automation, analytics, and operational improvements that enable sustainable growth.
  • Exceptional executive communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with experience influencing senior leadership and building strong external partnerships, including platform partners and creator agencies.
  • Highly entrepreneurial, highly adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where building new capabilities and leading through change are critical to success.
  • Experience partnering with international teams or supporting global ecommerce expansion is highly desirable.

Our Culture & Commitment

At SharkNinja, our purpose is to positively impact people's lives every day in every home around the world. We thrive on passion, innovation, and a relentless drive to disrupt categories and create products consumers love.

We're looking for leaders who embrace bold thinking, move with speed, challenge the status quo, and build scalable businesses that fuel our next phase of growth.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion are fundamental to our success. We believe diverse perspectives drive better innovation and stronger business outcomes. Our Culture

At SharkNinja, we don’t just raise the bar—we push past it every single day. Our Outrageously Extraordinary mindset drives us to tackle the impossible, push boundaries, and deliver results that others only dream of. If you thrive on breaking out of your swim lane, you’ll be right at home.

What We Offer

We offer competitive health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, employee stock purchase options, wellness programs, SharkNinja product discounts, and more. We empower your personal and professional growth with high impact Learning Programs featuring bold voices redefining what’s possible. When you join, you’re not just part of a company—you’re part of an outrageously extraordinary community. Together, we won’t just launch products—we’ll disrupt entire markets.

At SharkNinja, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion are vital to our global success. Valuing each unique voice and blending all of our diverse skills strengthens SharkNinja’s innovation every day. title: Front Door Greeter Part Time
description:
A World-Class Team

BJ’s Wholesale Club is powered by more than 30,000 team members who make a real impact every day. Whether you're stocking shelves, solving problems or shaping strategy, your work helps families save on what matters most.

We’re a team built on purpose and opportunity. Join us and be part of something meaningful.

Why You’ll Love Working at BJ’s

At BJ’s Wholesale Club, our team members are at the heart of everything we do. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, well-being and future – both on and off the job. When you grow, we grow.

Here’s just some of what you can look forward to:

Members:
